hf.title: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
hf.abstract: Streaming audio-visual target speaker extraction (AVTSE) is essential for latency-sensitive applications. However, current causal systems face two coupled gaps. First, standard benchmarks fix the number of speakers at two and ignore the near-/far-field interference, reverberation, and sudden noise of real scenes. Second, high-performance causal architectures are too heavy for edge deployment. Lightweight alternatives try to reclaim capacity by repeatedly invoking a small separator, which offsets the savings. To address the first gap, we release RealSSA, a realistic AVTSE benchmark consisting of RealSSA-Sim and RealSSA-Real. RealSSA-Sim provides controllable simulated scenes with 1--5 dynamic near-field interfering speakers; scenes with far-field interference additionally include 10--15 far-field interfering speakers. RealSSA-Real provides a held-out real-recorded evaluation set. To address the second gap, we propose Falcon, a causal AVTSE method. Its Separator performs multi-scale time-frequency separation in a single encoder--decoder pass. We train Falcon with an encoder-space speaker contrastive loss. This loss suppresses near-field leakage at zero inference cost and transfers across backbones. Falcon achieves state-of-the-art extraction quality on RealSSA-Sim, LRS2-2Mix, LRS3-2Mix, and VoxCeleb2-2Mix. Compared with the causal AV-TFGridNet baseline, it cuts parameters by 91.9%, computation by 20.2 times, and GPU inference latency by 11.1 times. Code and demo are available at https://cslikai.cn/Falcon/.
hf.titleZh: 面向真实声学场景的高效流式音视频目标说话人提取
hf.summaryZh: 针对流式音视频目标说话人提取在真实场景下评测失真与模型过重的问题，构建 RealSSA 基准：RealSSA-Sim 支持1–5个动态近场干扰说话人，远场场景另含10–15个远场干扰源，并提供真实录音的留存评测集；同时提出因果方法 Falcon，其分离器在单次编解码中完成多尺度时频分离，并以编码器空间说话人对比损失在零推理开销下抑制近场泄漏。Falcon 在 RealSSA-Sim、LRS2-2Mix、LRS3-2Mix、VoxCeleb2-2Mix 上取得最优提取质量，相较因果 AV-TFGridNet 基线参数量减少91.9%、计算量降至1/20.2、GPU 推理延迟降至1/11.1。
hf.reason: 音视频语音分离与基准，属语音应用低分方向

hf.title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
hf.abstract: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do not explicitly specify the 3D structure that connects these observations. In addition, existing training data do not guarantee that viewpoint changes preserve the same underlying 3D subject. We present OmniShowcase, built on two components: (i) a fully automated data synthesis pipeline that produces training videos along diverse camera trajectories, with viewpoint variation driven by underlying subject geometry, even spanning full 360-degree orbits; and (ii) a geometry-conditioning method that provides the video model with a turntable of surface-normal maps reconstructed from the reference views without requiring temporal alignment with the generated frames. We construct Showcase-4K, a corpus of 3D-asset-based videos covering twelve camera motions across 88 trajectory configurations with reconstruction-derived surface-normal conditioning, and ShowcaseBench, a held-out evaluation set with the source meshes and camera parameters used to render each video. Experiments show state-of-the-art subject identity and 3D consistency while maintaining competitive video quality and motion. Project page: justin4ai.github.io/OmniShowcase
hf.titleZh: OmniShowcase：从多视角图像生成全方位主体一致的视频
hf.summaryZh: 从少量参考图生成特定主体的视频时，当相机转到输入中未出现的表面，主体外观与几何需要模型自行推断，容易失真。OmniShowcase 用两个组件应对：一套全自动数据合成管线，按底层主体几何驱动相机轨迹（可覆盖完整 360 度环绕）生成训练视频；以及一种几何条件注入方法，把从参考视角重建的表面法线图以转盘形式提供给视频模型，无需与生成帧做时间对齐。作者构建了 Showcase-4K（基于 3D 资产、涵盖 12 种相机运动与 88 种轨迹配置）和带源网格与相机参数的评测集 ShowcaseBench，实验在主体身份保持与 3D 一致性上达到最优，同时视频质量与运动表现保持竞争力。
hf.reason: 视频生成与3D一致性方向，属低分清单

hf.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
hf.abstract: Robot foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, motivating low-cost offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To test this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment (S^2), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that S^2 correlates positively with downstream robot task success across model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. S^2 can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, S^2 offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With S^2, we extend PRH to robotics and make sensorimotor alignment measurable, offering a low-cost, representation-level view of robot foundation models that closed-loop success rates alone cannot reveal.
hf.titleZh: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
hf.summaryZh: 针对机器人基础模型依赖高成本闭环评测的问题，提出免训练的离线指标 S²( Sensorimotor Alignment)，用模型感官表征与物理运动几何的一致性来衡量能力。实验显示 S² 在不同模型族上与下游任务成功率正相关，可在闭环评测前低成本筛选模型，并提前识别有潜力的 VLM 主干以降低 VLA 微调成本。该工作把柏拉图表征假设扩展到机器人领域，为 VLA 与世界动作模型中的现象提供表征层面解释。
hf.reason: VLA/具身策略评测，属机器人方向，按画像一刀切低分

hf.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
hf.abstract: Agentic services alternate between model inference on clustered GPUs and external tools on distributed CPUs. In this scenario, existing systems (1) overlook tool-return readiness in service evaluation, wasting limited resources, and (2) use heuristic strategies to decide admission and placement on GPUs, resulting in suboptimal scheduling decisions. To bridge this gap, we present TAO, a tool-aware joint scheduling framework for LLM-based agentic serving. Its value interface combines near-term tool readiness, node-specific cache credit with time-aware decay, and token footprint; a dynamic program jointly selects and places waiting sessions under capacity constraints. Across the 12 reported model-workload-concurrency settings, TAO reduces latency by up to 26.8%, reduces mean time to first token (TTFT) by up to 36.3%, and increases decode throughput by up to 29.5% relative to the best evaluated state-of-the-art baseline for each metric.
hf.titleZh: TAO：面向基于 LLM 的 Agentic 服务的工具感知联合调度
hf.summaryZh: 针对 Agentic 服务中模型推理与外部工具调用交替进行的场景，现有系统在服务评价中忽略工具返回就绪状态、且 GPU 准入与放置依赖启发式策略，造成资源浪费与次优调度。TAO 提出工具感知的联合调度框架：价值接口融合近期工具就绪度、带时间衰减的节点级 cache credit 与 token footprint，并用动态规划在容量约束下联合选择与放置等待会话。在 12 组模型—负载—并发设置中，相较各指标最优基线，延迟最多降低 26.8%，平均 TTFT 最多降低 36.3%，decode 吞吐最多提升 29.5%。该工作适用于 Agent 推理服务的调度与资源管理。
hf.reason: Agentic 服务调度与推理系统效率，直接命中 Agent 与系统方向

hf.title: RealCLI: Toward a Unified Evaluation of Human-Agent Collaboration for CLI Agents
hf.abstract: Command-line interface (CLI) agents increasingly execute longer-horizon tasks, yet existing benchmarks either assume that user instructions remain fixed throughout execution or evaluate task outcomes without capturing runtime collaboration quality. In this paper, we present REALCLI, a paired benchmark that unifies the evaluation of task execution and human-agent collaboration quality on realistic CLI tasks. To comprehensively measure collaboration, REALCLI builds a five-dimensional framework, operationalized into 22 sub-dimensions and 51 interaction scenario templates. REALCLI provides two modes for paired comparison: REALCLI-EXEC supplies complete specifications upfront, whereas REALCLI-COLLAB introduces a scripted user that delivers progressive information, corrections, constraint revisions, and authorization decisions. Evaluations reveal profound capability gaps in frontier agents: the best configuration attains an average score of only 49.2%, and when evaluated by the joint collaboration score (J_{collab}), the peak performance reaches merely 37.6%. These results show that task effectiveness diverges sharply from collaboration quality, with models consistently struggling in steerability, trust calibration, and safety boundary management. REALCLI provides a rigorous, reproducible foundation for measuring and advancing collaborative CLI agents.
hf.titleZh: RealCLI：迈向 CLI 智能体人机协作的统一评测
hf.summaryZh: 现有 CLI 智能体基准要么假定用户指令在整个执行过程中固定不变，要么只评测任务结果、不捕捉运行时的协作质量。RealCLI 构建成对基准：用五维框架、22 个子维度与 51 个交互场景模板刻画协作，并提供两种配对模式——EXEC 一次性给出完整规格，COLLAB 则由脚本化用户逐步提供信息、纠错、修改约束并做授权决策。评测显示前沿模型存在显著能力缺口：最佳配置平均分仅 49.2%，联合协作分 J_collab 峰值仅 37.6%，任务完成效果与协作质量明显脱节，模型在可引导性、信任校准与安全边界管理上系统性偏弱。该基准为可复现地衡量并推进协作式 CLI 智能体提供了基础。
hf.reason: CLI Agent 人机协作评测基准，直接命中 Agent 与评测方向

hf.title: PersonaCUABench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents Serving Diverse Personas
hf.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are commonly evaluated against fixed task specifications, but users may omit requirements, add constraints, or require approval before consequential actions. Completing the benchmark instruction does not guarantee serving the person who asked. We introduce PersonaCUABench, which holds 74 tasks across 11 domains fixed and varies only who asks. A persona agent, playing one of 44 personas in four groups, rewrites each instruction in that user's own words and answers the CUA's questions, while the CUA sees only the dialogue, never the profile or the original instruction. Across nine backbones (3,330 runs), mean task completion falls by 36% relative to the original requests. The losses have two sources: in 59.9% of cells that lose points, the agent engages with what the user asked for and still gets it wrong, and 11.2% are stops the user requested that the checker scores as failures. Even when a persona request is fully completed, the user gives the top satisfaction rating in only 62.7% of cells, against 84.1% for the original requests. CUAs should therefore be evaluated not only on task completion but also on whether they meet the requirements and constraints users express. Code: https://github.com/MatrAIx-ai/PersonaCUABench. Project page: https://matraix.ai/research/persona-cua.html
hf.titleZh: PersonaCUABench：评测服务多样化用户画像的计算机使用智能体
hf.summaryZh: 现有CUA评测多在固定任务描述下进行，但真实用户会省略需求、追加约束或要求关键操作前确认，完成任务并不等于服务好提问者。PersonaCUABench固定11个领域74个任务，只改变提问者：44个画像分四组，由画像智能体用该用户的口吻改写指令并回答CUA的追问，CUA只能看到对话。在九个基座上共3330次运行中，平均任务完成率相对原始请求下降36%；失分案例中59.9%是智能体按用户所说执行却仍出错，11.2%是用户要求的停止被判定为失败。即使任务完整完成，最高满意度评价也仅占62.7%（原始请求为84.1%），表明CUA评测需同时覆盖用户表达的需求与约束。
hf.reason: Agent评测方法学，揭示固定指令评测盲区，实验数据扎实

hf.title: TauIndianBankBench: Procedure-Aware, Action-Oriented Evaluation of Tool-Using Conversational Agents
hf.abstract: Many Indian banks serve customers through FAQ pages and scripted chatbots. Assistants based on language models could respond faster and carry out requests such as blocking a card, but only if they give correct information and follow the bank's rules. These rules prescribe a procedure, a set of required steps, such as obtaining a closure quote before closing a deposit. Adapting models to this domain requires measuring how well they follow the procedure, before and after training. Benchmarks usually judge only the records left at the end of a conversation. Many required steps, however, leave the records unchanged, so an assistant that skips them can still be judged successful. We present TauIndianBankBench, an action-oriented benchmark of 1,000 Indian retail-banking tasks where an assistant helps a simulated customer. Besides the final records, it checks that the assistant took every required step and made no unrequested change. For every model, 6.5-12.0% of sessions are judged successful when only the final records are checked, although the assistant skipped a required step or made an unrequested change. Scoring both procedure and outcome shows more accurately how well language models perform in Indian retail banking.
hf.titleZh: TauIndianBankBench：面向流程、以行动为导向的工具使用对话智能体评测
hf.summaryZh: 现有基准多只检查对话结束时的最终记录，而银行流程中许多必需步骤（如销户前先取closure quote）并不改变记录，导致跳过步骤的助手仍被判成功。构建了 1000 个印度零售银行任务的基准，由助手服务模拟客户，同时校验最终记录、每个必需步骤是否执行以及是否存在未被请求的更改。结果显示，各模型有 6.5%–12.0% 的会话在仅看最终记录时被判成功，实际却漏做了必需步骤或做了多余改动。该工作说明过程级评分对工具型智能体的真实能力评估不可省略，适用于银行等强合规流程场景。
hf.reason: 工具智能体的过程级评测基准，命中 Agent 与评测方法学方向

hf.title: Amortizing Sequential Experimental Design in Reasoning LLMs
hf.abstract: Despite their extensive pretraining knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, large language models (LLMs) struggle to adaptively gather information in experimental design tasks. We study how to amortize sequential Bayesian experimental design (BED) into an LLM by explicitly training the reasoning that guides action selection using information-gain rewards. Our approach specifies the experimental generative model independently of the LLM's own beliefs, allowing us to optimize expected information gain under a model of our choosing. We investigate the design choices for amortization, including alternative generative-model constructions, reward estimation, hypothesis-space specification, multi-step objectives, and computational costs relative to training- and inference-time BED baselines. On Twenty Questions, the resulting policies improve information acquisition and task performance, outperform inference- and training-time BED baselines at substantially lower computational cost, and generalize to unseen categories. We further demonstrate positive transfer from Twenty Questions training to Medi-Q, a real-world clinical dialogue benchmark. These results suggest that information gathering can be learned as a generalizable reasoning skill in LLMs.
hf.titleZh: 将序贯实验设计摊销进推理LLM
hf.summaryZh: LLM 虽有丰富的预训练知识与较强推理能力，却难以在实验设计任务中自适应地收集信息。该工作用信息增益奖励显式训练「引导动作选择」的推理过程，把序贯贝叶斯实验设计(BED)摊销进模型参数，并让实验生成模型独立于 LLM 自身信念，从而在自选模型下优化期望信息增益;同时系统考察生成模型构造、奖励估计、假设空间设定与多步目标等设计选择。在 Twenty Questions 上，所得策略提升了信息获取与任务表现，以显著更低的计算成本优于推理时与训练时 BED 基线，并可泛化到未见类别;在真实临床对话基准 Medi-Q 上也观察到正向迁移。结果表明信息收集可以作为可泛化的推理技能被学习，对后训练中的奖励设计与 Agent 信息搜集有参考价值。
hf.reason: 信息增益奖励训练推理，命中后训练与Agent信息收集，但任务规模偏小

hf.title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
hf.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model learns from tasks it proposes itself, has achieved excellent performance, but existing methods target short-context tasks. Therefore, we propose LongZero, a method that lets an LLM improve its own long-context reasoning without any external data. Instead of writing questions and answers over existing documents, LongZero first has the model synthesize the question and answer with its supporting evidence in a compact structured form, and only then separately expands the evidence into a long multi-document context. LongZero combines these self-written multi-hop reasoning tasks with self-written multi-round retrieval tasks and trains the model with GRPO. We evaluate LongZero on two LLMs across five long-context reasoning benchmarks and compare it with RL on data synthesized from external corpora. Experimental results show that LongZero can generalize to real tasks, and outperforms both baselines, suggesting a viable and promising path to improving long-context reasoning of LLMs.
hf.titleZh: LongZero：从零数据增强 LLM 的长上下文推理
hf.summaryZh: 长上下文强化学习依赖长而多样、可验证的训练数据，人工标注昂贵、自然数据稀缺，现有合成方法又依赖外部语料或更强的教师模型。LongZero 让模型先以紧凑的结构化形式自行生成问题、答案与支撑证据，再单独把证据扩展成多文档长上下文，并把自写的多跳推理任务与多轮检索任务结合，用 GRPO 训练。在两个 LLM、五个长上下文推理基准上，该方法能泛化到真实任务，并优于基于外部语料合成数据的 RL 基线，为无外部数据的长上下文自我进化提供了可行路径。
hf.reason: 零数据自写任务 + 长上下文 GRPO 后训练，直接命中关注方向

hf.title: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks
hf.abstract: As frontier language models grow increasingly capable and autonomous, independent third-party evaluations are critical for characterizing their systemic safety risks. While closed-source releases are routinely accompanied by comprehensive system cards, open-weight models receive less scrutiny regarding frontier risks. To address this gap, we present an independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017, the latest version of V4.1 Flash that departs from V4 with a new architecture, scaled-up training, and strong agentic capabilities. Drawing on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, we evaluate the model across 34 benchmarks, including 5 in-house suites, spanning evaluation integrity, loss of control, and harmful manipulation. Conforming to the AEF-1 standard, we compare V4.1 Flash-1017 against V4.1 Flash, earlier DeepSeek V4 models, and leading closed-source systems (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash). Overall, V4.1 Flash-1017 shows substantial safety improvements over the V4 generation and approaches or matches leading closed-source baselines on several dimensions, while still exhibiting notable behaviors that warrant continued attention. Building on our findings, we highlight three key observations and recommendations. First, because safety can shift and even regress across minor updates, developers should integrate safety evaluation into incremental releases. Second, as final-turn outputs and end-state checks alone cannot reliably detect loss-of-control behaviors, deployments require process-level observability across both reasoning traces and action logs. Third, because public benchmarks elicit strong evaluation awareness and face data contamination risks, developing private benchmarks is essential for trustworthy frontier evaluation.
hf.titleZh: 评估 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 的失控与有害操纵风险
hf.summaryZh: 开源权重模型缺少前沿风险的第三方评估，本文参照欧盟 GPAI 行为准则设计评估框架，覆盖评估完整性、失控与有害操纵三类风险，共 34 个 benchmark（含 5 个自建套件），按 AEF-1 标准将 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 与 V4.1 Flash、早期 V4 及 GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol、Gemini 3.8 Flash 横向对比。结果显示，其安全性较 V4 世代显著提升，多个维度接近或匹配领先闭源基线，但仍存在值得持续关注的行为。作者据此建议将安全评估纳入增量发布流程，在推理轨迹与动作日志上做过程级可观测性，并建设私有 benchmark 以规避评测感知与数据污染。
hf.reason: 前沿模型第三方安全评测，命中评测与对齐方向

hf.title: CausGround: Causal Interaction Grounding for Adaptive Embodied Planning
hf.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promising reasoning capabilities, but reliable physical interaction requires planning that accounts for when actions are executable and how they change the world. These preconditions and effects are environment-dependent and often not captured by MLLMs, making adaptation challenging. Yet existing approaches either require costly environment-specific training or rely on unstructured interaction experience that is difficult to reuse. Therefore, we introduce CausGround, a non-parametric causal interaction grounding framework that distills interaction experience into reusable action-centered causal knowledge. CausGround identifies action preconditions and effects and organizes them in a factorized world-state representation capturing object attributes and inter-object relations. At planning time, task-relevant causal dependencies are grounded in current observations to support backward reasoning over preconditions and forward reasoning over effects for action selection and multi-step planning. We evaluate CausGround on simulated high-level planning, interaction reasoning, and real-world robot manipulation. On adapted VirtualHome and RoboCasa benchmarks, CausGround improves vision-based high-level planning across MLLM backbones, increasing average task success from 24.9% to 53.3% on VirtualHome and closed-loop planning success from 43.0% to 57.0% on RoboCasa. On SWITCH, average interaction reasoning accuracy increases from 25.8% to 31.9%, indicating improved action selection, recovery, and verification. Moreover, real-world experiments show that CausGround reasons backward from MLLM-interpreted goals to derive executable high-level action sequences for sequential manipulation. These results demonstrate that reusable action preconditions and effects support long-horizon embodied planning across diverse environments without parameter updates.
hf.titleZh: CausGround:面向自适应具身规划的因果交互接地
hf.summaryZh: 多模态大模型难以判断动作何时可执行、执行后如何改变世界，而这类前置条件与效果依赖具体环境;现有做法要么需昂贵的环境专属训练，要么依赖难以复用的非结构化交互经验。CausGround 将交互经验蒸馏为可复用的、以动作为中心的因果知识，显式识别动作前置条件与效果，并以分解式世界状态表示组织物体属性与物体间关系;规划时把任务相关因果依赖接地到当前观测上，用前置条件反向推理、效果正向推理来选动作与多步规划，全程不更新参数。在 VirtualHome 上视觉高层规划平均任务成功率由 24.9% 升至 53.3%,RoboCasa 闭环规划成功率由 43.0% 升至 57.0%,SWITCH 上交互推理准确率由 25.8% 升至 31.9%，并在真实机器人顺序操作中由 MLLM 解析的目标反推可执行动作序列。
hf.reason: 具身智能与机器人操作，按画像归低分方向

hf.title: LOB-Impact Benchmark: Emergent Market Impact in Generative Limit Order Book Models
hf.abstract: Realistic market impact is essential for generative limit order book (LOB) models to serve as world models for trading agents. If a simulator misprices this mechanism, agents learn policies that are optimal in the simulator but wrong in the real market. Existing metrics assess generated streams purely through distributional comparison with historical data, leaving counterfactual response to an agent's own orders largely unexplored. Here, we show that market impact emerges naturally in neural LOB generators trained solely for next-token prediction. We inject execution-style metaorders into the generated message flow of five autoregressive models across five NASDAQ stocks and measure the response using estimators from the empirical impact literature, validated on baselines whose physics is known in advance. Our benchmark evaluates any message-level generator in three phases: free generation (reading order-flow persistence against price diffusivity); metaorder injection (yielding the impact law's exponent and amplitude); and a post-execution window (measuring relaxation). In addition, comparing each visible injection to a blind, simulator-only control isolates the model's learned response from standard book mechanics. For every model on every stock, we measure how the impact responds as a function of cumulative metaorder participation. Interestingly, we observe emergent impact in generative models of market data, with exponents in the range of 0.63 to 1.21, slightly above the traditional 0.5 of the square-root law of impact. In the family of models tested, we are so far unable to observe impact decay during relaxation. We tentatively attribute this to the still-short context windows of the models. We release the benchmark as open source to validate future generative models for market data.
hf.titleZh: LOB-Impact 基准：生成式限价订单簿模型中的涌现市场冲击
hf.summaryZh: 生成式限价订单簿模型如果要充当交易 Agent 的世界模型，就必须复现真实的市场冲击；现有指标只把生成流与历史数据做分布比对，不检验模型对 Agent 自身下单的反事实响应。该基准分三阶段评测任意消息级生成器：自由生成阶段考察订单流持续性与价格扩散性；metaorder 注入阶段拟合冲击律的指数与幅度；执行后窗口阶段测量松弛，并用仅模拟器的盲对照剥离订单簿机械效应。在五个 NASDAQ 股票与五个自回归模型上，注入执行型 metaorder 后涌现出指数为 0.63–1.21 的市场冲击，略高于平方根律的 0.5；受模型上下文窗口仍偏短所限，尚未观察到松弛期的冲击衰减。
hf.reason: 金融 LOB 生成模型评测，属垂直应用，仅与 Agent 世界模型沾边

hf.title: PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues
hf.abstract: GUI grounding requires locating small controls in cluttered screenshots and identifying which control a natural-language instruction refers to. Cropping and enlargement can expose local detail, but the resulting image may still leave ambiguity about the intended target. We propose PreView, an auxiliary preprocessor that improves the inputs to an existing grounding model without further training that model. PreView prepares two complementary types of input features: task-relevant views for localization and candidate-specific cues for target understanding. A trained lightweight auxiliary model predicts and refines a center, crops the screenshot into a local view, and enlarges that view for zoomed-in grounding. It also prepares a visual cue (i.e., a red-circle marker with a location hint) and a textual cue describing the candidate's identity or function. The frozen grounding model uses the prepared inputs to predict the final click. Across five benchmarks, PreView improves the average grounding accuracy of Qwen3-VL-2B, OS-Atlas-4B, and Qwen3-VL-4B without further training these grounding models. Extensive analyses examine the contributions of views and cues, center refinement, and visual input budgets.
hf.titleZh: PreView:用预处理视图与线索增强 GUI grounding
hf.summaryZh: GUI grounding 需要在杂乱截图中定位小控件并判断指令所指目标，裁剪放大后仍可能歧义。PreView 作为不重训 grounding 模型的辅助预处理器，训练轻量模型预测并细化目标中心，裁剪出任务相关局部视图并放大，同时生成红圈标记加位置提示的视觉线索与描述候选身份的文本线索，供冻结的 grounding 模型预测最终点击。在五个基准上，PreView 无需额外训练即提升 Qwen3-VL-2B、OS-Atlas-4B 与 Qwen3-VL-4B 的平均 grounding 准确率，并分析了视图、线索、中心细化与视觉输入预算的贡献。
hf.reason: GUI grounding 预处理增强，属 Agent 感知环节的扎实工作

hf.title: Know, then Draw: A New Learning Paradigm for Visual Generation
hf.abstract: Visual generation requires both high-level semantic knowledge and fine-grained pixel details. We propose a learning paradigm that assigns these roles to autoregressive pretraining for knowledge acquisition and diffusion post-training for high-fidelity rendering. Within this framework, we study the objective, representation, and scaling of knowledge acquisition and rendering. Controlled comparisons identify autoregression as the stronger pretraining objective for downstream rendering, improving both learning efficiency and final generation quality. We further find that AR-only generation quality does not necessarily correlate with final performance; semantic quality matters more. This motivates a purely semantic tokenizer trained with language supervision alone, without an image decoder or reconstruction loss. We establish compute-optimal scaling laws for knowledge acquisition and rendering, and find that autoregressive pretraining lowers the fitted asymptotic rendering loss compared with pixel diffusion models trained from scratch. Guided by the laws, we train a 3B-parameter text-to-image model with only 6,600 H100 GPU-hours, achieving 86 on GenEval and 87 on DPG-Bench and validating the proposed paradigm at scale.
hf.titleZh: 先知晓，再绘制:视觉生成的新学习范式
hf.summaryZh: 视觉生成同时需要高层语义知识与像素级细节，该工作把两者拆给两个阶段:自回归预训练负责知识获取，扩散后训练负责高保真渲染。受控对比显示自回归是更强的预训练目标，且纯自回归生成质量与最终效果并不必然相关，语义质量更为关键;据此提出仅用语言监督训练、不含图像解码器与重建损失的纯语义 tokenizer。作者还建立了知识获取与渲染的计算最优 scaling law，发现自回归预训练相比从零训练的像素扩散模型降低了拟合的渐近渲染损失，并据此用 6600 H100 GPU 小时训练出 3B 文本到图像模型，GenEval 达 86、DPG-Bench 达 87。
hf.reason: 属视觉生成方向，仅自回归预训练与 scaling law 沾边

hf.title: Instruction Capacity: Behavior and Degradation of Language Models under Controlled Load
hf.abstract: The quality with which language models follow instructions falls as the load grows, yet there is still no quantity that expresses the limit of a model in units of load with an uncertainty. We propose an instrument in which the load consists of rules that replace single-token words in a text without meaning: such an instruction is atomic, the rules are independent by the construction of the task, and the outcome of every application of a rule is determined by a computable reference answer. Every occurrence of a word to be replaced becomes a Bernoulli trial with a known position in the answer and a known rule number. The statistical model first measures the shape of the dependence of the probability of a right replacement on the text length, the word position, the replacement density, the number of rules and the rule number, then describes it by smooth laws and restores a reference level that does not depend on the choice of the coding. The model yields the instruction capacity - the number of rules held at a given share of right replacements - with an uncertainty. A measurement of GPT-4o mini (2958 requests, 642,430 trials) gave regular laws for every load factor and for the collapse of the answer; the instruction capacity was about 37-38 rules at a share of right replacements of 0.95, and about 18-19 rules at the full replacement density. The code of the instrument, the measurement data and the passport are open, and every number of the passport is recomputed from the published points. The passport of a model serves as the calibration of a future meter of the instruction load of prompts.
hf.titleZh: 指令容量：语言模型在受控负载下的行为与退化
hf.summaryZh: 针对语言模型随指令负载增加而遵循质量下降、却缺乏带不确定度的负载极限度量的问题，将负载设计为在无意义文本中按独立规则替换单词，使每次替换成为位置和规则编号已知的伯努利试验，并用统计模型拟合正确替换概率随文本长度、词位置、替换密度、规则数与规则编号的变化，进而估计给定正确率下的指令容量及不确定度。对GPT-4o mini的2958次请求、642430次试验测得0.95正确率下容量约37到38条规则，满替换密度下约18到19条，可作为提示指令负载计的校准。
hf.reason: 指令遵循负载的量化评测工具，属评测方法学扎实工作

hf.title: HuGe: Scaling Humanoid Generalist Vision-Language-Action Models with Egocentric Experience
hf.abstract: Extending Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) to humanoid robots requires coordinated whole-body control and diverse demonstrations that are costly to collect in real-world scenarios. Although egocentric human demonstrations provide a complementary source of task experience, differences in visual embodiment and missing robot proprioception complicate transfer to humanoid policies. To address these challenges, we introduce HuGe, a family of Humanoid Generalist VLAs pre-trained on over 2,000 hours of egocentric human and robot data. Specifically, HuGe employs three existing representative VLA architectures to predict latent motion tokens for a pretrained whole-body controller, together with hand-control signals. Based on this, we introduce a three-stage training pipeline that combines egocentric pre-training, humanoid adaptation, and downstream fine-tuning. To facilitate transfer across embodiments, we construct pseudo-proprioceptive states through simulation playback during pre-training and modify arm appearance in egocentric observations through re-rendering during downstream fine-tuning. With this pipeline, HuGe achieves the state-of-the-art on simulation benchmark HumanoidArena. Furthermore, real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 indicate that augmenting robot demonstrations with visually adapted egocentric demonstrations significantly increases success on a pick-and-drop task.
hf.titleZh: HuGe:用第一人称视角经验扩展人形通用视觉-语言-动作模型
hf.summaryZh: 人形机器人的全身控制策略依赖昂贵的真机示范，第一人称人类数据虽能补充任务经验，却存在视角差异与缺失本体感知导致的迁移障碍。HuGe 基于三种代表性 VLA 架构，预测预训练全身控制器的隐式运动 token 与手部控制信号，并配套第一人称预训练、人形适配、下游微调的三阶段训练流程:预训练时通过仿真回放构造伪本体感知状态，微调时重渲染改变手臂外观以缩小跨本体视觉差异。该方案在仿真基准 HumanoidArena 上取得 SOTA,Unitree G1 真机实验表明，用视觉适配后的第一人称示范增广机器人数据可显著提升抓取放置任务的成功率。
hf.reason: 人形机器人 VLA，落在画像中具身智能低分方向

hf.title: OmniSpectra: A Unified Foundation Model for Universal Spectra Representation Learning
hf.abstract: Standard sequence models encode position by token rank rather than physical coordinate, typically forcing practitioners to destructively resample continuous physical signals such as spectra observed across heterogeneous instruments. We identify this coordinate mismatch as a structural limitation in cross-instrument representation learning, and propose OmniSpectra, a wavelength-native foundation model for spectral representation learning: a continuous-coordinate masked autoencoder that discards the integer pixel indexing of sequence modeling. Mapping physical coordinates to a logarithmic basis turns the multiplicative scaling induced by cosmological redshift into a uniform additive shift. In continuous rotary position embeddings, this shared shift cancels from relative token distances rather than producing grid-dependent positional distortion. We further counter the spectral bias inherent to implicit neural decoders with a physics-grounded, resolution-gated Fourier decoder that provides anti-aliasing. Pretrained on eight surveys and benchmarked against seven baselines, our model reaches state-of-the-art performance with only 12.2M parameters while outperforming substantially larger models, indicating that encoding physical structure can substitute for parameter scale.
hf.titleZh: OmniSpectra:面向通用光谱表示学习的统一基础模型
hf.summaryZh: 标准序列模型按 token 序号而非物理坐标编码位置，导致跨仪器观测的连续物理信号(如光谱)必须被破坏性重采样。该工作把物理坐标映射到对数基，使宇宙学红移带来的乘性尺度变化转为统一的加性平移，并在连续旋转位置编码中让该平移从相对 token 距离中抵消，避免网格相关的定位畸变;同时用分辨率门控的傅里叶解码器抑制隐式神经解码器的谱偏置并提供抗混叠。在八个巡天数据集上预训练、对比七个基线，以仅 12.2M 参数取得 SOTA 并超过更大模型，说明编码物理结构可替代参数规模。
hf.reason: 天文光谱基础模型，仅位置编码沾边架构方向

arxiv.title: Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution
arxiv.abstract: Data attribution methods for Language Models (LMs) are typically evaluated using downstream tasks like fact retrieval. However, existing evaluations vary multiple dataset properties simultaneously, making it impossible to isolate exactly why an attribution algorithm fails. To diagnose these failures, we explore the design space of LLM data attribution, with a primary focus on evaluation. We introduce the Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT) for fact tracing, in which we fine-tune LLMs on entirely fictitious knowledge, providing unambiguous ground truth for attribution. This synthetic setup allows us to systematically alter one dataset configuration at a time, such as document redundancy and lexical distractors. With this configurable evaluation, we demonstrate that redundancy and distractors consistently degrade attribution performance. Rather than proposing a new estimator, we examine two design choices that are underexplored: the loss used to compute gradients and how per-token attribution scores are aggregated into a document score. We find that the true causal evidence within a training document is highly localized, but standard methods dilute this evidence into noise by averaging attribution scores across the entire document. We find that replacing standard cross-entropy loss gradients with the negative log-odds gradients surfaces the critical tokens from other uninformative ones. We can then aggregate only the top token scores to improve ground truth recall by 35 to 72 percentage points across multiple baselines on our diagnostic benchmark. The negative log-odds correction also generalizes to FTRACE-TREX, improving counterfactual retraining performance for every method we test, by up to 4.9x.
arxiv.titleZh: 厘清语言模型数据归因的设计空间
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对语言模型数据归因评测中多种数据属性同时变化、难以定位失败原因的问题，构建受控基准CATT:用完全虚构的知识微调模型以获得无歧义真值，并可逐项调节文档冗余、词法干扰等配置。诊断发现冗余与干扰项会持续削弱归因效果，且文档内真实因果证据高度局部化，整篇平均归因分数反而把证据稀释为噪声。以负对数几率梯度替代交叉熵梯度可凸显关键token，仅聚合头部token分数即在多个基线上把真值召回率提升35–72个百分点，迁移到FTRACE-TREX后反事实重训练指标最高提升4.9倍。
arxiv.reason: 归因评测方法学扎实，但与后训练、Agent主线略偏

arxiv.title: Propose-Filter-Release: Scaling Noise to Typical Sensitivity via Private Filtering
arxiv.abstract: An estimator can be accurate and stable on typical data, yet sensitive to a few possible records. Differentially private mechanisms commonly scale their noise to the worst-case influence of a single record, which lets these records dictate the noise even when the remaining data would allow far less. Removing them first would restore the smaller scale, but the removal must itself be private. We introduce \emph{propose-filter-release} (PFR), which, by privately filtering its input, turns a mechanism that protects the addition or removal of a typical record, one that fits the remaining data, into one that is differentially private in the standard sense, on every input. Using our novel filtering step, PFR requires only a concave friendliness score, which measures how well a record fits a dataset, and a release mechanism that is friendly-DP, that is, private when the changed record fits the remaining data. For every such score and release mechanism, it guarantees differential privacy under public conditions on the number of records, so it is a general privacy primitive, comparable to propose-test-release, and FriendlyCore can be viewed as one of its implementations. We illustrate the generality of PFR by instantiating it for scalar statistics, principal subspace estimation, the KL divergence of user histograms, the effective resistances of a graph, and treatment-rule selection.
arxiv.titleZh: 提议-过滤-发布:通过私有过滤把噪声缩放到典型敏感度
arxiv.summaryZh: 差分隐私机制通常按单条记录的最坏影响来设定噪声，少数敏感记录会主导噪声尺度，即便剩余数据本可支持更小的噪声。PFR 先对输入做私有过滤，把只保护"典型记录"增删的 friendly-DP 机制升级为标准意义下对任意输入都成立的差分隐私机制;它只需一个凹的 friendliness 分数(衡量记录与数据的契合度)和一个 friendly-DP 发布机制，在记录数公开的条件下即给出隐私保证，是与 propose-test-release 同级的通用隐私原语，FriendlyCore 可作为其一种实现。论文在标量统计、主子空间估计、用户直方图的 KL 散度、图的有效电阻与治疗方案选择上给出实例化。
arxiv.reason: 差分隐私理论原语，与 LLM 关注方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations
arxiv.abstract: The Neural Thickets hypothesis posits that pretrained language models lie in dense neighborhoods of task-specific experts in weight space, which random Gaussian perturbations can uncover. We reproduce the reported gains, but show that they do not require this geometric explanation. Perturbing a single decoder block already recovers much of the improvement, while keeping the model entirely frozen and adding a random bias to its output logits matches or exceeds full-weight perturbations on most reasoning tasks. This suggests an alternative explanation based on output diversity, validation-based selection, and voting. We formalize this view as Perturb-Select-Vote (PSV), a general procedure that generates perturbed predictors, selects high-performing members on a small validation set, and aggregates their predictions. This interpretation connects Neural Thickets to established inference-time methods, including sampling, self-consistency, and verifier-guided selection. A first-order analysis further shows that small weight perturbations act primarily through their induced logit shifts. We extend this analysis to vision, where logit PSV substantially improves performance under domain shift, including on Earth observation, while full-weight perturbations provide little additional benefit. Together, these results suggest that the gains attributed to nearby weight-space experts can instead be obtained through output diversity, selection, and voting. Logit PSV realizes these benefits with a fully frozen model, providing a simple, training-free alternative to full-weight perturbation ensembles across language and vision.
arxiv.comment: Project page can be found here: https://kyutai.org/logit-psv
arxiv.titleZh: 重新思考无权重扰动的 Neural Thickets
arxiv.summaryZh: 复现 Neural Thickets 报告的增益，但表明其几何解释并不必要:仅扰动单个 decoder block 就能恢复大部分提升，而完全冻结模型、只在输出 logits 上加随机偏置，在多数推理任务上即可匹敌甚至超过全权重扰动。工作将其形式化为 Perturb-Select-Vote(PSV):生成扰动预测器、在小验证集上挑选高性能成员、再聚合预测，并与采样、self-consistency、verifier 引导选择等推理期方法建立联系;一阶分析显示小权重扰动主要通过诱导的 logit 偏移起作用。方法在视觉域偏移场景(含对地观测)同样带来明显提升，为语言与视觉任务提供了一种免训练、全冻结的集成替代方案。
arxiv.reason: 推理期多样性+选择投票再分析，贴近 test-time scaling 方向

arxiv.title: world2vec: Mechanistic world models through latent dynamics learning
arxiv.abstract: World models can achieve strong control performance without faithfully capturing the dynamics of their environment, limiting their potential for mechanistic interpretability and scientific discovery. Here, we introduce world2vec to learn mechanistic world models without reward information directly from observations and actions. World2vec learns latent dynamics that faithfully reproduce the true system over long prediction horizons, with at least one order of magnitude fewer parameters than DreamerV3, TD-MPC2 and LeWM. This enables state of the art performance in controlling continuous environments from pixels and accurate system identification across a benchmark of 71 attractors, demonstrating how world models are amenable to scientific discovery.
arxiv.titleZh: world2vec：通过潜在动力学学习构建机制性世界模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有世界模型即使不忠实刻画环境动力学也能取得较强的控制性能，这限制了它们的可解释性与用于科学发现的潜力。world2vec 不使用奖励信息，仅从观测与动作中学习潜在动力学，在长预测时域上忠实复现真实系统，参数量比 DreamerV3、TD-MPC2 与 LeWM 至少少一个数量级。该方法在基于像素的连续控制环境中取得当前最优性能，并在 71 个吸引子基准上完成准确的系统辨识，展示了世界模型用于科学发现的可能性。
arxiv.reason: 世界模型与基于模型的控制 RL，与 LLM 主线无交集

arxiv.title: ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender
arxiv.abstract: Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often. This brittleness has a mechanistic root: Alignment is shallow, with safety behavior concentrated in a model's first few output tokens, and existing defenses inherit the weakness, supervising the surface form of the response without ever giving the model an explicit safety decision to learn. We take the opposite view of shallowness: if a short span determines the trajectory of an entire response, that span is the highest-leverage place to intervene, and the defender can occupy it first. We propose Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond, a framework in which the defender assesses the user's intent, commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision, and only then generates a reply conditioned on it, with the commitment trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn. Because the decision is a token span, the reward can be a rule: a self-verified reward checks the committed label against the conversation's known nature, requiring no judge and no annotation, while the same format also supports an LLM-as-judge reward over a graded decision space with safe redirection. Across two model families and fourteen benchmarks spanning safety, utility, and helpfulness, our defenders achieve the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison, maintaining their lead in safety while preserving utility at a modest cost to helpfulness. A per-token KL analysis and interventional probes confirm why this works: training concentrates its effect on the brief deliberation that sets a response's trajectory, and the decision committed there is a causal control point. The very shallowness attackers exploit becomes the mechanism of defense.
arxiv.titleZh: ShallowDefend：利用浅层安全对齐构建多轮对话防御者
arxiv.summaryZh: 多轮对话中，把有害请求拆散到多轮往往仍能绕过模型的安全拒绝，其机制根源在于对齐是浅层的:安全行为集中在输出最前面几个 token，现有防御沿袭这一弱点，只监督回复的表面形式，从未给模型一个显式的安全决策去学习。方法上采用 Assess → Decide → Respond 框架:防御方先评估用户意图，提交一个显式、可解析的安全决策 token span，再以该决策为条件生成回复，并在 payload 轮上用强化学习训练这一承诺;由于决策只是一段 token，奖励可用规则实现(自验证奖励对照对话已知性质校验标签，无需 judge 与标注)，同一格式也支持 LLM-as-judge 在分级决策空间上给奖励并做安全重定向。在两个模型家族、覆盖安全、效用与有用性的 14 个 benchmark 上，受控比较中取得最强的多轮安全性，并在保持安全领先的同时保留效用，有用性仅有适度代价;逐 token KL 分析与干预探针显示，训练效果集中在决定回复轨迹的那段短暂权衡上，此处提交的决策是因果控制点。适用场景为多轮对话安全对齐与可验证奖励的 RL 后训练。
arxiv.reason: 利用浅层对齐做多轮安全防御，RL 训练显式决策，命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Testimony from Timelines: Evidence-Grounded Significance Testing of Temporal Clinical Hypotheses
arxiv.abstract: Ask a language model whether sales tend to dip after a product recall, or whether one side effect tends to follow another after a vaccine, and it answers in a fluent sentence that reads like a finding, with no test behind it. Assertions about how events unfold across many cases fill the Web, and each is a temporal hypothesis that only a significance test over the right records can settle. The verifier must specify the null, select the test and decide which records bear on the hypothesis, and any of these choices can go wrong while the conclusion still comes out right. Yet benchmarks for language-model data analysis grade only the conclusion, with the relevant data handed over. We study the problem in health, where a wrong verdict is costly, and present STRATA, a benchmark that grades every decision on the way to a verdict: 8,735 hypotheses over the clinical timelines of vaccine adverse-event reports, with gold plans, evidence sets, p-values and verdicts derived under a released codebook and reproduced by a deterministic oracle. We also propose ART (articulate, retrieve, test), a staged paradigm that exposes each decision as an inspectable output. Extensive experiments with five model configurations show that systems fail mostly at choosing which records count, a verdict-evidence gap that accuracy alone conceals. ART closes most of this gap and brings a 31B open model to within 0.01 of the frontier models under the same paradigm; the frontier models succeed once given the codebook.
arxiv.titleZh: 来自时间线的证词：时序临床假设的证据支撑显著性检验
arxiv.summaryZh: 语言模型常对“某事件是否倾向在另一事件后发生”给出流畅断言，却无显著性检验支撑；现有基准只评最终结论，且直接交出相关数据。STRATA基准基于疫苗不良事件报告的临床时间线构建8,735条假设，标注检验方案、证据集、p值与结论，由确定性oracle按公开codebook复现并逐项评分通往结论的每个决策；ART范式将表述、检索、检验三阶段暴露为可检查输出。五种模型配置的实验显示，系统主要失误在判断哪些记录算数，形成准确率掩盖的结论—证据鸿沟；ART缩小该鸿沟，31B开源模型与前沿模型差距仅0.01，前沿模型在获得codebook后即可成功。
arxiv.reason: 临床时序假设的LLM统计检验基准，方法学有价值但偏医疗领域

arxiv.title: An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models
arxiv.abstract: The marginals of a continuous diffusion model can be reproduced by a deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE), known as the probability flow ODE, which provides a foundation for accelerated sampling and consistency distillation. In this paper we address the question whether an analogous formulation exists for discrete diffusion models and answer it affirmatively by introducing exponential residual flows (ERFs). Our framework augments the discrete state with a continuous residual variable for each token and position. These residuals evolve deterministically according to piecewise-defined ODEs whose vector fields depend on the current discrete state and the forward and backward rate matrices of the prescribed diffusion model. The discrete state changes whenever a residual reaches zero. We prove that this construction preserves the marginals of the original diffusion. We derive a practical discretization of our sampler and specialize it to masked and uniform diffusion. The deterministic trajectories of ERFs support consistency distillation and yield empirical improvements over previous approaches across a variety of benchmarks including code and text generation tasks.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向离散扩散模型的 ODE 采样器
arxiv.summaryZh: 离散扩散模型缺乏类似连续扩散中概率流 ODE 的确定性采样与蒸馏基础。该工作引入指数残差流（ERF），为每个 token 与位置增广一个连续残差变量，使其按分段 ODE 确定性演化；当残差归零时，离散状态发生跳变，并证明该构造保持原扩散的边际分布。作者给出该采样器的实用离散化，并特化到 masked 与 uniform 扩散。确定性轨迹可支撑一致性蒸馏，在代码与文本生成等基准上取得相对已有方法的实证提升。
arxiv.reason: 离散扩散采样理论，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 主线关联弱

arxiv.title: When to Assist and What to Suggest: Joint Gating and Memory-Grounded Hint Generation in One Compact Decoder
arxiv.abstract: Proactive assistants offer short, memory-grounded hints during a conversation, deciding when to assist and what to suggest. Current systems split this between a gate and a larger generator; we evaluate both together on 28,058 decision points. Stage-wise generation scores are oracle-gate ceilings: behind a real gate, end-to-end exact match is 0.2619 against a ceiling of 0.2971, and end-to-end precision is 0.2387, leaving substantial headroom. A gate pays off through precision and compute, whose saving falls from 4.39x with an 8B generator to 1.38x with a 1B one. The memory profile drives hint quality: removing it costs 24.7 exact-match points (rescaled BERTScore 0.57 to 0.35), while retrieval and a larger generator add nothing on exact match. One 1B decoder can do both, gating from an intermediate layer and generating in the same pass. At its final checkpoint it matches or exceeds the two-model pipelines on automatic end-to-end measures with 1.31-1.76x less wall-clock time than the matched 1B pipeline; across three seeds, its deeper exit ties the separate gate. A human evaluation (1,144 ratings over 32 dialogues) supports the memory effect and rates the single model level with the matched 1B pipeline and below the 8B one. Graded metrics and LlamaPIE's native judge track human ratings more closely than exact match, which we report as a strict lower bound.
arxiv.comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 13 tables; supplementary material included (Sections S1-S8)
arxiv.titleZh: 何时介入、建议什么：在单一紧凑解码器中联合门控与记忆接地提示生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 主动式对话助手既要判断何时介入，又要给出以记忆为依据的提示；现有做法把门控和更大的生成器拆成两套，分别评估。该研究在28,058个决策点上联合评测二者：端到端精确匹配为0.2619，而oracle门控上限为0.2971；去掉记忆画像会损失24.7个精确匹配点（BERTScore由0.57降至0.35），而检索和更大生成器对精确匹配都没有增益。单个1B解码器在中间层做门控，并在同一次前向中生成提示；其最终检查点在自动端到端指标上追平或超过双模型流水线，耗时少1.31–1.76倍；1,144条人工评分支持记忆效应。
arxiv.reason: 面向对话主动助手的门控与记忆提示，方向擦边、分量有限

arxiv.title: Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
arxiv.abstract: An autonomous research laboratory could conduct an entire study, from formulating questions to preparing manuscripts. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers one route towards this goal. Recent AI systems take on several research roles, but may draw conclusions that the evidence does not support. Here, we present an autonomous research laboratory in which agents based on large language models assess one another's work and can stop or redirect investigations. They can generate and reject research questions, require separate theoretical checks and conduct experiments designed to challenge their claims. We demonstrate these capabilities by investigating ensembles of quantum spins in diamond. The agents derived the minimum number of calibration settings needed to predict responses to a defined family of microwave pulse sequences. They checked the result computationally and designed experiments to distinguish competing predictions. An initial experiment agreed with the theoretical predictions, but repeated reference measurements showed that the signal was drifting during data collection. The agents therefore treated the result as inconclusive and revised the measurement protocol without relaxing the acceptance criteria. The revised experiment met those criteria and supported the theoretical predictions. This study demonstrates that collaborating AI agents can select research questions, derive theoretical results and test their predictions experimentally.
arxiv.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Code available at https://github.com/E-zClap/auctopus
arxiv.titleZh: 面向固态量子自旋自主实验研究的协作式AI智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 构建了一个由大语言模型智能体组成的自主研究实验室，智能体之间相互评审、可中止或改写正在进行的研究路线，并能自主生成与否决研究问题、要求独立的理论校验、设计旨在挑战自身结论的实验。系统以金刚石中的量子自旋系综为对象，推导出预测给定微波脉冲序列族响应所需的最少校准参数数目，通过计算验证并设计实验区分相互竞争的理论预测。首轮实验与理论一致，但重复参考测量显示采集过程中信号存在漂移，智能体据此判定结果不确定并修订测量方案，同时不放松验收标准，修订后的实验满足标准并支持理论预测。该工作展示了多智能体协作完成从选题、理论推导到实验验证的闭环自主科研流程，适用于AI for Research与科研智能体系统设计。
arxiv.reason: AI for Research科研智能体闭环系统，含自我评审机制

arxiv.title: Pre-Crime for Agents, at the Last Second: Probing When a Recruited Agent Gives In
arxiv.abstract: When AI agents share channels and credentials, one agent can press another to break its operator's rule, a first step towards collusion. Output filters check only what an agent has already written. Can an overseer tell beforehand that an agent is about to give in? We show that a linear probe on the agent's activations can, in a controlled multi-agent setting. Across six scenarios, a peer presses a target for up to 20 rounds to reveal a secret, such as a deploy token; the target often refuses, then gives in. Read at each model call before its output is written, the probe picks out the one that leaks. On held-out Qwen3-32B episodes, at a threshold set to flag 5% of benign calls, it catches 82% of leaking calls. At a similar flag rate, a zero-shot decision-model monitor catches 26%. On gpt-oss-20b, a probe on its reasoning reaches AUROC 0.91. A bag-of-words classifier trained on the same calls comes close, so most of the gain comes from training on labels, not activations. The probe also flags permitted disclosures: it reads the coming disclosure more than the violation. The warning is short-range, and halting on any alarm would stop most benign episodes, which a second text check does not fix. A warning raised before generation could let an overseer stop an agent that is about to give in, ahead of others acting on its messages or recruitment spreading through a swarm.
arxiv.titleZh: Agents 的预犯罪:在最后一秒探测被招募的 Agent 何时妥协
arxiv.summaryZh: 多 Agent 共享通道与凭证时，一个 Agent 可能被同伴施压而违反自身运营方的规则，迈向串谋的第一步，而输出过滤只能检查已经写出的内容。该工作在受控多 Agent 场景中让同伴在至多 20 轮内诱导目标泄露部署 token 等秘密，并在每次模型调用写出前对激活做线性探针，以预测即将发生的泄露。在 Qwen3-32B 的留出 episode 上，阈值设定为误报 5% 良性调用时，探针捕获 82% 的泄露调用，同误报率下零样本决策模型监控仅 26%;在 gpt-oss-20b 的推理内容上探针 AUROC 达 0.91。词袋分类器在相同数据上接近该效果，说明增益主要来自标签训练而非激活本身;探针还会标记被允许的披露，警告作用范围短，且对任一告警即中止会停掉大多数良性 episode。
arxiv.reason: 多 Agent 安全监控，方法扎实但探针增益有限

arxiv.title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
arxiv.abstract: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital environments. VLM judges are restricted to supplied observations, while generated programs depend on accessible state. These views can omit decisive evidence or leave completion judgments unsupported. Tailoring separate verifiers to different platforms and access settings adds further engineering cost. We present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verification through agentic exploration. It treats verification as dynamic evidence gathering and assessment within a shared procedure for online and offline settings across platforms and observation modalities. After inspecting the available context to construct a task rubric, the verifier selects GUI or code checks for unresolved requirements and combines their findings under explicit evidence rules. Experiments show improved agreement with reference labels over the compared baselines across these settings, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online. Further analyses connect these gains to complementary evidence and test-time exploration.
arxiv.titleZh: VeriCUA:将验证作为智能体探索，面向计算机使用智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 计算机使用智能体(CUA)在桌面、移动与网页环境的规模化，依赖可靠的任务完成验证，但VLM裁判受限于给定的观测，生成的检查程序又只能看到可访问的状态，容易漏掉决定性证据;而为不同平台分别定制验证器又会抬高工程成本。VeriCUA把验证建模为智能体在共享流程中的动态取证与判定:先检视可用上下文构建任务rubric，再针对尚未满足的要求选择GUI检查或代码检查，并按显式证据规则合并结果，同一套流程覆盖在线与离线、跨平台与多观测模态。实验显示其与参考标签的一致度优于对照基线，离线设置在困难样例上增益最大，在线设置对虚假完成声明的拒绝更强;分析表明收益来自互补证据与测试时探索。
arxiv.reason: 面向CUA的智能体验证框架，直接服务Agent数据与环境构建

arxiv.title: Multi-View MoE: Letting Every Router Shape Expert Computation
arxiv.abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand parameter capacity by activating a small subset of experts per token. Expert selection directly affects model capabilities under a fixed active-expert budget. Dense evaluation of all experts reveals weak agreement between single-router rankings and expert-utility evaluation rankings, especially in middle and deep layers. Richer signals for selection and computation incur additional cost: selection based on internal expert activations requires preliminary computation, while processing multiple full representations separately through the same expert repeats its computation. We propose Multi-View MoE to improve expert selection with multiple routers and reuse their preferences to modulate expert computation under a fixed expert budget. Its Multi-Router submodule aggregates sigmoid scores from independently initialized routers. These routers develop highly differentiated expert preferences during training, allowing experts strongly favored by one router or jointly supported by several routers to be selected. Multi-View further uses each selected expert's relative scores across routers to mix learned latent views into its input, reusing routing preferences for both selection and computation. Each selected expert executes one forward pass, preserving the active-expert count, expert FLOPs, and all-to-all communication volume. On a 24-layer 10B-A1B model trained on 708B tokens, full Multi-View MoE improves the nine-task downstream mean by 1.18 percentage points over the baseline. Multi-Router alone yields a 0.6-percentage-point gain and improves the rank correlation between router scores and evaluated expert utility, with relative increases of 8.1% globally and approximately 58% in the layer with the lowest single-router alignment. Controlled mixing interventions show the model uses input differences that depend on both the expert and the token.
arxiv.titleZh: 多视角MoE：让每个路由器塑造专家计算
arxiv.summaryZh: 稀疏MoE中专家选择直接决定固定激活预算下的模型能力，而对全部专家做稠密评估显示，单路由器排名与专家效用评估排名在中层和深层层一致性较弱。提出Multi-View MoE：多路由器子模块聚合多个独立初始化路由器的sigmoid分数，训练中这些路由器形成高度差异化的专家偏好；再利用被选专家在各路由器上的相对分数，将学习到的潜视角混合进其输入，使路由偏好同时用于选择与计算。每个被选专家仍只做一次前向，激活专家数、专家FLOPs与all-to-all通信量均不变。在24层10B-A1B模型上训练708B token，九任务下游均值较基线提升1.18个百分点，仅多路由器即提升0.6个百分点，并将路由器分数与专家效用的秩相关全局提升8.1%，单路由器对齐最差的层提升约58%。
arxiv.reason: MoE路由与专家计算新机制，命中LLM架构方向且有实测增益

arxiv.title: PIVOT: Progressive Intervention via Online Teacher Correction
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is limited by sparse outcome-level feedback on hard reasoning tasks: when all rollouts in a group fail, rewards provide no learning signal. Stronger teachers can provide additional guidance, but this raises a central question: how can such signals be incorporated into RLVR to support successful rollouts while remaining learnable for the student? We distinguish two complementary mechanisms: trajectory-level intervention, which improves access to reward-bearing trajectories, and token-level supervision, which provides dense targets to guide student learning. Our controlled experiments show that either mechanism alone can remain insufficient, motivating their combination. We therefore introduce PIVOT, which inserts teacher-generated corrections into student rollouts and applies token-level KL supervision to these segments alongside the RLVR objective. Beyond their combination, we systematically analyze where to intervene and how to supervise, yielding a recipe for effective guidance. Across hard logic games and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, PIVOT consistently outperforms existing methods, nearly doubling mean avg@8 on logic games from 19.5% for the best-performing baseline to 35.6%.
arxiv.comment: 19 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://zhihaoyang30.github.io/PIVOT/
arxiv.titleZh: PIVOT:通过在线教师纠正的渐进式干预
arxiv.summaryZh: RLVR 在困难推理任务上受限于稀疏的结果级反馈:当一组 rollout 全部失败时，奖励不提供任何学习信号。PIVOT 把教师生成的纠正片段插入学生 rollout，并对这些片段施加 token 级 KL 监督、与 RLVR 目标联合优化;实验区分了轨迹级干预(提升含奖励轨迹的可达性)与 token 级监督(提供稠密目标)，表明二者单独使用均不足、必须组合。在困难逻辑游戏与数学推理基准上稳定优于现有方法，逻辑游戏 avg@8 从最强基线的 19.5% 提升到 35.6%，接近翻倍，并给出「在哪干预、如何监督」的可复用配方。
arxiv.reason: RLVR 稀疏奖励结合教师纠正与 token 级蒸馏，直击后训练方向

arxiv.title: Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation
arxiv.abstract: On-policy Self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models by constructing a teacher conditioned on privileged references. However, existing approaches keep the teacher fixed either throughout training by consistently exposing it to the full reference, or within each response by adaptively varying partial reference exposure only across responses. In this paper, we argue that neither of them is sufficient. Instead, every token needs its own teacher, as the teacher preference can vary token by token within the same response. Through a teacher-intervention pilot study, we validate that the teacher preference differs across tokens, and reveal that a preferred teacher can be identified for each token through majority voting and KL-based selection. Motivated by these findings, we propose Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation (MTA-OPSD), the first token-level adaptive OPSD method. Our method constructs a multi-teacher pool consisting of candidate teachers, and enables every token to adaptively select its preferred teacher during training. Experiments with Qwen3 models on mathematical reasoning tasks show that MTA-OPSD consistently outperforms existing OPSD approaches with an average gain of up to $+5.9$ over the base model, highlighting the importance of adapting teacher supervision at the token level. The code is available at https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD.
arxiv.titleZh: 每个 token 都需要自己的教师：多教师自适应 on-policy 自蒸馏
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 on-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）要么全程让教师接触完整参考，要么仅在 response 级别调整参考的暴露比例，忽略了同一回复内不同 token 对教师偏好的差异。通过教师干预的预实验，验证了逐 token 的教师偏好确实存在，并可用多数投票与 KL 选择稳定识别出更优教师。据此提出 MTA-OPSD：构建候选教师池，训练时让每个 token 自适应挑选最合适的教师施加监督。在 Qwen3 数学推理任务上，该方法稳定优于现有 OPSD，相比基座模型平均提升最高 +5.9，表明把教师监督细化到 token 级能带来实际收益。
arxiv.reason: on-policy 自蒸馏的 token 级自适应教师选择，正打后训练方向

arxiv.title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
arxiv.abstract: Foundation models are typically trained in stages: pretraining, midtraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL), with changes in both data and learning algorithms. We show that this algorithmic separation is not fundamental. By deriving suitable RL objectives as maximum-likelihood fitting to model-generated target distributions, we place all of these stages under a single likelihood-based training algorithm, unified training. This perspective turns the foundation-model training lifecycle into a problem of choosing which data to train on, in what proportions, and when, with conventional staged training as a special case. We instantiate this framework in a unified training system that mixes static data and RL generations within a single trainer. Across controlled and real-world experiments, unified training improves the accuracy-compute tradeoff and task coverage while preserving broader capabilities, and provides a stronger starting point for continual learning. This work lays the groundwork for a unified science of foundation-model training, connecting mathematical principles, training infrastructure, and the development of model capabilities.
arxiv.titleZh: 用单一算法训练基础模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 把预训练、中训练、SFT与RL统一为同一个基于似然的训练算法：将RL目标推导为对模型自生成目标分布的最大似然拟合，使各阶段从算法切换转变为「选什么数据、按什么比例、何时训练」的数据调度问题。在单一trainer内混合静态数据与RL生成样本，受控与真实实验中在保持通用能力的同时改善精度—算力权衡与任务覆盖，并为持续学习提供更强起点。该框架把数学原理、训练基础设施与能力演化连成一体，为统一的训练科学奠定基础。
arxiv.reason: 预训练、SFT与RL统一为单一似然算法，直击后训练核心

arxiv.title: Comparing Human Role-Players and LLM-Simulated Clients in Online Counselling Training: An Analysis of Counselling Patterns
arxiv.abstract: This study investigates the capabilities of Large Language Models to simulate counselling clients in educational role-plays in comparison to human role-players. Initially, we recorded role-playing sessions, where novice counsellors interacted with human peers acting as clients, followed by role-plays between humans and clients simulated by Mistrals Mixtral 8x7b using 4-bit quantization. These interactions were analysed with a counselling communication pattern system at sentence level. We investigated two key questions: (1) to what extent LLM-generated responses replicate authentic conversational dynamics and (2) whether counsellors' communication behaviour differs when interacting with human versus LLM-simulated clients. The findings highlight both similarities and differences in the application of counselling patterns across scenarios, showing the potential of LLM-based role-playing exercises to enhance counselling competencies and to identify areas for further refinement in virtual client simulations.
arxiv.comment: Published at EDM 2025 (18th International Conference on Educational Data Mining), short paper. 7 pages
arxiv.titleZh: 比较人类角色扮演者与LLM模拟来访者在在线心理咨询培训中的表现：咨询模式分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 考察LLM能否在心理咨询教学的角色扮演中替代真人来访者。研究录制新手咨询师分别与人类同伴、以及4-bit量化的Mistral Mixtral 8x7b模拟来访者的对话，在句子级用咨询沟通模式编码体系分析。结果显示两种情境下的咨询模式既有相似也有差异，说明LLM角色扮演可用于训练咨询胜任力，同时指出了虚拟来访者模拟需要改进之处。该工作属于LLM在教育垂直场景的应用，与后训练、Agent等方向交集有限。
arxiv.reason: LLM教育角色扮演应用，属垂直行业场景，与方法学关注弱相关

arxiv.title: FARMS: A Verifiable Foundation for Automated Computational Science
arxiv.abstract: Automated computational science could accelerate discovery by selecting, adapting and developing numerical methods. This prospect requires mathematical knowledge that AI systems can interpret and reuse with explicit guarantees. Here we present FARMS, a faithful and efficient foundation that transforms computational mathematics into AI-ready computing knowledge. FARMS connects formal statements to source context, algorithmic meaning and quantitative guarantees through source preparation, reusable representations and semantic review. Across 171 targets in randomized numerical linear algebra and numerical partial differential equations, 157 were accepted by the pipeline, with mean estimated costs of US \$0.85-2.29 per target across sources. Lean-checked implications from explicit source premises connect selected statements to computational skills, illustrated by a heat-flow solve and wave-response compression. FARMS therefore supports an affordable, reusable knowledge foundation for trustworthy automated computational science.
arxiv.titleZh: FARMS：自动化计算科学的可验证基础
arxiv.summaryZh: 自动化计算科学需要 AI 能解释、可复用且有显式保证的数学知识，为此构建 FARMS，把计算数学转化为 AI 可用的计算知识：经源材料准备、可复用表示与语义审阅三个环节，将形式化陈述与来源上下文、算法语义及定量保证连接起来。在随机数值线性代数与数值偏微分方程的 171 个目标上，流水线接收 157 个，单目标估计成本 0.85–2.29 美元；由显式源前提出发、经 Lean 校验的蕴含关系把选定陈述与计算技能相连，并以热流求解与波动响应压缩为例演示。该工作为可信自动化计算科学提供了低成本、可复用的知识底座。
arxiv.reason: AI for Research 知识底座与形式化验证，擦边但非 LLM 核心

arxiv.title: Advancing Clinical Genomic Analysis with a Skill-Centred Agent
arxiv.abstract: Clinical genomic analysis requires experts to integrate evolving guidelines, databases, and computational evidence. As sequencing has become increasingly accessible, this complex and labor-intensive process has become a major bottleneck to the timely use of genomic information in clinical decision-making. To fill this gap, we developed ClinGeX, a large-language-model agent that composes 105 curated executable skills through task-specific retrieval and dependency-aware orchestration. On 223 temporally held-out benchmark cases, ClinGeX achieved 71.7\% macro-averaged task-level concordance with expert reference classifications, compared with 45.7\% for the strongest comparator. In a three-condition, counterbalanced human-AI collaboration study, 45 clinical genomic professionals assessed 135 clinically derived cases under routine (no AI assistance), DeepSeek-assisted and ClinGeX-assisted conditions. ClinGeX assistance increased raw case-level concordance across criterion-level variant analysis, genomic interpretation in rare disease and molecular oncology decision-making (51.1\%, 57.8\%, 64.4\% versus 15.6\%, 31.1\%, 20.0\% in comparator conditions) and reduced reported interpretation time in all scenarios. During an exploratory one-month real-world non-interventional assessment, 11 experienced professionals submitted feedback on 96 self-selected analysis episodes and reported frequent conclusion adoption and time savings. These findings support executable domain skills as a promising approach to augment specialist genomic interpretation.
arxiv.titleZh: 以技能为中心 Agent 推进临床基因组分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 临床基因组分析需要专家整合不断更新的指南，数据库与计算证据，是基因组信息进入临床决策的瓶颈。ClinGeX 把 105 个经人工整理的可执行技能通过任务特定检索与依赖感知编排组合成 LLM Agent;在 223 个时间留出基准病例上，任务级宏观一致率为 71.7%，最强对比方法为 45.7%。45 名临床基因组专业人员参与的三条件交叉实验显示，使用 ClinGeX 辅助后病例级一致率在变体分析，罕见病解读与肿瘤决策场景分别达 51.1%,57.8%,64.4%，并普遍缩短解读时间。该结果表明可执行领域技能编排是增强专家解读的可行路线。
arxiv.reason: Agent 技能编排有参考价值，但落在临床基因组垂直应用

arxiv.title: Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs
arxiv.abstract: As AI's mathematical capabilities rapidly improve, meaningful benchmarks are shifting from university-level problems and math olympiads to research-level mathematics. The Ramanujan Challenge is a benchmark comprised of research-level problems in number theory, including unpublished results and open conjectures. It presented concrete formulas for mathematical constants whose correctness can be checked numerically, while their proofs may require non-obvious mathematics. Here, we analyze the Challenge submissions, measuring the relative success of different AI models, Computer Algebra Systems (CAS), and formal tools. We find correct submissions that are conceptually distinct from the official solutions, and a proof of one of the published open conjectures. Evaluating the submissions exposed a second challenge: judging complex proofs reliably at scale. We introduce an AI-assisted evaluation pipeline for natural language proofs, CAS code, and Lean formalizations that assesses semantic and logical correctness. Compared with the conventional one-shot LLM judgment, our pipeline reduces false-positive verdicts on natural language proofs from 23% to 6% and improves judgment accuracy on supporting code from 46% to 58%. This approach provides a methodology for evaluating research-level mathematics at scale, with potential applications across mathematics and AI for science.
arxiv.titleZh: Ramanujan Challenge 结果：面向多格式证明的 AI 辅助评估流水线
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究级数学正成为新的评测前沿，Ramanujan Challenge 收录数论领域的未发表结果与开放猜想，要求给出可数值校验的常数公式并附证明。本文分析该挑战的提交，比较不同 AI 模型、计算机代数系统（CAS）与形式化工具的相对表现，发现与官方解答思路迥异的正确证明，并给出其中一个公开开放猜想的证明。针对大规模可靠判定复杂证明这一难题，提出覆盖自然语言证明、CAS 代码与 Lean 形式化的 AI 辅助评估流水线，从语义与逻辑两个层面评估正确性；相比一次性 LLM 判定，自然语言证明的误判率由 23% 降至 6%，支撑代码的判定准确率由 46% 提升至 58%。该流程为规模化评估研究级数学提供了可复用方法，可迁移到更广泛的 AI for Science 场景。
arxiv.reason: LLM-as-judge 评估流水线有方法学价值，但主体是数学基准

arxiv.title: Retrieval as Traversal: Value-Indexed Memory for Stateful Long-Context Agents
arxiv.abstract: Long-context models repeatedly solve closely related retrieval problems. Attention or global retrieval can retain large stores, but each forward pass again searches for what matters. Recurrent compression avoids this search only by deciding earlier what information to preserve. Neither mechanism directly exploits that useful memories at neighbouring retrieval steps may substantially overlap. We propose an alternative in which retrieval is a persistent local traversal through an address space. We separate a memory's content from its address. Utility is defined by the information revealed by retrieving the content, while geometry determines only how cheaply that information can be reached. This leads to a cost-regularised indexing objective that preserves information value inside local neighbourhoods while charging for every memory made locally accessible. Its marginal-value form gives both attractive and exclusion pressures. Thus, complementary memories should be co-retrievable when the additional value exceeds retrieval cost, whereas redundant memories should not occupy the same retrieval set solely because they are individually useful. As a proof of principle, we test only the simplest fixed-geometry instance on MiniGrid Memory. A persistent local traversal head reaches $0.95$ mean return after $0.59$M training steps with a five-token context, compared with $0.94$M for Gaussian absolute addressing and more than $2$M for categorical absolute addressing. The experiment does not test learned geometry or repeated retrieval. Instead, it motivates the hypothesis that stateful retrieval may be easier to learn than stateless. To test the full proposed method further experimentation is necessary.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Long-Context Foundation Models (LCFM). 7 pages, 1 table
arxiv.titleZh: 检索即遍历:面向有状态长上下文 Agent 的值索引记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 长上下文模型在相邻检索步中反复处理高度重叠的记忆需求，而注意力与全局检索每次前向都要重新搜索，循环压缩则提前决定保留什么、放弃了后续灵活性。该工作把检索改为在地址空间中持续进行的局部遍历，将记忆的内容与地址分离:效用由检索内容所揭示的信息量定义，几何只决定到达该信息的代价，由此得到代价正则化的索引目标，其边际价值形式同时产生吸引与排斥压力，使互补记忆可被共同检索、冗余记忆不因各自有用而挤占同一检索集。在 MiniGrid Memory 上仅测试最简单的固定几何实例，持续局部遍历头在 5 token 上下文下用 0.59M 训练步达到 0.95 平均回报，而高斯绝对寻址需 0.94M、类别绝对寻址需 2M 以上。结果仅为原理验证，尚未验证可学习几何与重复检索，但提示有状态检索可能比无状态检索更易学习，对 Agent 记忆机制设计有参考价值。
arxiv.reason: Agent 记忆与长上下文检索选题有趣，但仅 MiniGrid 小规模验证，分量有限

arxiv.title: Machine Learning-Based Detection of Mobile Money Scan Messages in Ghana: A Comparative Evaluation of Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine, and Randon Forest Classifiers
arxiv.abstract: Mobile money (MoMo) is Ghana's preferred retail payment channel, recording GHC518.4 billion in transactions in December 2025 and over 26.7 million active accounts (Graphic Online, 2026). This growth has coincided with increased social-engineering fraud over Short Message Service (SMS) and Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD), where fraudsters impersonate network operators, agents, relatives, or regulators to obtain personal identification numbers (PINs), identity data, or funds. We present a supervised machine-learning pipeline for classifying scam and legitimate Ghanaian MoMo SMS messages using a labelled corpus of 220 messages across 18 scam and legitimate subcategories. Domain-specific normalisation of currency amounts, phone numbers, and USSD codes preceded TF-IDF vectorisation of unigrams and bigrams. Using stratified five-fold cross-validation and a 20% held-out test set, we trained and evaluated Multinomial Naive Bayes, linear support vector machine (SVM), and Random Forest classifiers using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC). Held-out accuracy, F1, and AUC were 1.00 for Naive Bayes and linear SVM; cross-validated accuracy averaged 96.6% (+/-3.3), 94.9% (+/-4.6), and 92.0% (+/-4.2). Discriminative n-grams reflected imperative urgency ("send," "claim," "please send") and PIN solicitation ("PIN," "pincode"); legitimate messages featured confirmatory and cautionary language ("balance," "successful," "do not share"). Findings are contextualised in Sub-Saharan African SMS fraud detection, small template-based corpus ceiling effects, and a pathway toward larger naturalistic multilingual corpora. Interpretable classical classifiers achieve high accuracy on structured MoMo scam text and suit carrier- or handset-level filtering in low-resource, on-device settings.
arxiv.titleZh: 加纳移动支付扫描短信的机器学习检测:Naive Bayes、支持向量机与随机森林分类器的比较评估
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对加纳移动货币(MoMo)短信与USSD渠道中冒充运营商、代理或监管者的社会工程诈骗，构建了含220条消息、覆盖18个诈骗与正常子类别的标注语料，并加入对金额、电话号码、USSD代码的领域归一化，再用TF-IDF提取unigram与bigram特征。在分层五折交叉验证与20%留出测试集上对比Multinomial Naive Bayes、线性SVM与随机森林，以准确率、精确率、召回率、F1、MCC与AUC-ROC评估。留出集上Naive Bayes与线性SVM的准确率、F1与AUC均达1.00，交叉验证平均准确率分别为96.6%(±3.3)、94.9%(±4.6)与92.0%(±4.2);判别性n-gram体现为催促性措辞与PIN索取，正常短信则多含确认与提醒用语。结果说明可解释的经典分类器在高结构化的MoMo诈骗文本上表现良好，适用于低资源、端侧或运营商侧的短信过滤，但语料规模与模板化带来的上限也限制了结论外推。
arxiv.reason: 经典分类器做短信诈骗检测，与LLM/后训练方向无交集

arxiv.title: On the Fundamental Limits of Prefill-Based Decoding Length Prediction
arxiv.abstract: Predicting how many tokens a large language model (LLM) will decode, using only prefill-phase hidden states, is a key primitive for inference scheduling. We show that current benchmarks conflate predictor quality with task hardness: when the target model, dataset, or sampling configuration changes, reported accuracy collapses even though the predictor is unchanged. We trace this instability to an overlooked error source---the inherent stochasticity of autoregressive decoding---and derive bounds that every prefill-side method must obey. Our analysis treats decoding as a stopped stochastic process. The per-step stopping probability of a response is not constant but ramps up over hundreds of steps, so the decode length inherits a central limit theorem from the many local decisions that determine where a response ends; this yields per-prompt normality with an explicit error term, together with an affine variance law $σ=αμ+b$ whose slope is the coefficient of variation of the number of response segments. Empirically, the normal law reproduces the per-prompt MAE and the central mass of the decode-length distribution to within a few percent, and the residual departures from normality (mild right skew, slight excess kurtosis) are the ones predicted by the sampling-noise correction. Under fixed model, data, and sampling conditions, a broad design space of predictors (MLP, EGTP, FiLM, soft-label, and Mixture-of-Experts variants) converges to similar performance close to the bound, confirming that \emph{system error dominates model error}. We argue for a benchmarking protocol that fixes the model, data, and sampling parameters and that reports relative-error metrics alongside absolute ones. Code and analysis tools are available at https://github.com/ShwStone/DecodingPredict.
arxiv.titleZh: 论基于 Prefill 的解码长度预测的根本性极限
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对仅用 prefill 阶段隐状态预测 LLM 解码长度这一推理调度基础问题，指出现有 benchmark 混淆了预测器质量与任务难度，模型、数据或采样配置一变，同一预测器的精度便大幅下降。将解码视为停止随机过程，逐步停止概率随步数上升使其长度服从中心极限定理，由此导出逐 prompt 正态性、显式误差项与仿射方差律 σ=αμ+b。实验显示该正态律对逐 prompt MAE 与分布中心质量的拟合误差在几个百分点内；固定模型、数据与采样条件后，MLP、EGTP、FiLM、soft-label、MoE 等预测器均收敛到接近理论界的性能，说明系统误差主导模型误差。据此主张固定条件并同时报告相对误差的评测协议。
arxiv.reason: 推理调度的解码长度预测理论界，系统效率方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: Efficient Scalable Oversight via Rewinding
arxiv.abstract: Scalable oversight asks how a weak verifier can check the outputs of computations performed by more powerful AI systems. One proposed approach uses relativizing interactive proofs, in which a weak verifier checks the output of a complex oracle-aided computation by interacting with one or more powerful provers. A prominent example is debate, which is highly efficient but assumes that one of two powerful AI models, or provers, is truthful. For certain classes of oracle-aided computations, this assumption can be removed, but at substantially greater computational cost. In this work, we introduce \emph{rewindable interactive proofs} (RIPs), a new model of relativizing interactive proofs for scalable oversight. In an RIP, the verifier may rewind the prover to an earlier state of the interaction and continue from there. This is possible when the prover is an AI model, since the verifier can save a snapshot of the model's state and later restore it. We construct a relativizing RIP for computations whose outputs are robust to changing a small fraction of oracle answers. Our construction is more efficient than prior relativizing proofs that do not assume a truthful prover, and it uses no cryptography. In our construction the honest prover runs in time linear in that of the original computation, and the verifier, after a one-time preprocessing step, runs in time nearly linear in the input length (which can be much smaller than the computation itself). We implement our protocol, report a preliminary MNIST experiment, and show that an RIP can be faster than a state-of-the-art deployed proof system. RIPs may be of independent interest. Rewinding is possible whenever the verifier controls the prover's machine, for example when the prover runs on trusted hardware or in a virtual machine whose state can be checkpointed.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过回卷实现高效可扩展监督
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对弱验证者如何检验更强AI系统输出这一可扩展监督问题，提出可回卷交互式证明（RIPs）：验证者可保存证明者（AI模型）状态快照并在交互中回卷到早期状态继续，从而在不假设证明者诚实、不使用密码学的前提下，为「输出对少量oracle答案变化稳健」的计算构造相对化交互证明。诚实证明者运行时间为原始计算的线性量级，验证者在一次性预处理后接近输入长度的线性时间，效率优于此前不假设诚实证明者的方案。已实现该协议并给出初步MNIST实验，显示其可快于现有部署的证明系统。
arxiv.reason: 可扩展监督与对齐方向的新协议，理论新颖但实验仅MNIST

arxiv.title: Homebrewed SLMs: Autoregressive and Masked Diffusion Language Models Built at Home for Portuguese
arxiv.abstract: Building a language model of one's own no longer requires a data centre. This tutorial trains one from scratch, tokenizer included, on one consumer GPU, and shows how to tell whether it is good for the tasks of a specialist domain. It proposes no new method. It releases a tested Python package and two notebooks in Brazilian Portuguese with autoregressive and masked diffusion generation on one network, a preregistered comparison protocol, legal tasks built from text alone with a Kneser-Ney floor and public yardsticks, reference numbers for models of 11 to 12M parameters, and a catalogue of defects that only measurement revealed. On Brazilian prose and federal laws, at minutes per run, the autoregressive mode peaks at 64 epochs over the same text and then memorises it, while masked diffusion improves up to 256. At their best points on test, the diffusion bound exceeds the autoregressive likelihood by 0.06 bits per byte, within the preregistered minimum effect. On held-out laws and on acts published after training, the model ties a 6-gram floor in likelihood on the same windows, and it loses to the floor at continuing those acts.
