It beats the floor at detecting tampered text, and fills cross-references more often than the floor and public models of 160M and 630M parameters, only in decrees, a genre absent from training, where those scorers stay near or below chance, and in filling the blank only when each group weighs the same, since per item it ties the 630M model. On laws, the public models, trained with about 5x10^2 to 10^5 times its compute, lead in tampered text and continuation. The blind human reading is preregistered and not part of this version.
arxiv.comment: 34 pages, 14 figures, 13 tables. Code and notebooks: https://github.com/pcbrom/homebrewed-slms
arxiv.titleZh: 自酿 SLM：在家为葡萄牙语构建的自回归与掩码扩散语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 用单张消费级 GPU 从零训练含 tokenizer 的小型语言模型，同一网络支持自回归与掩码扩散两种生成，并给出预注册对比协议、法律任务上的 Kneser-Ney 下限与公开基线。11–12M 参数模型在巴西散文与联邦法律上，自回归 64 epoch 后开始记忆，掩码扩散到 256 epoch 仍改善，测试集最佳点扩散似然界领先自回归 0.06 bits/byte。在训练后公布的法案上似然追平 6-gram，篡改文本检测优于下限，交叉引用填充在训练未见的法令体裁上超过 160M 与 630M 公开模型。可作为小模型自建与测量式评测的教学参考。
arxiv.reason: 小模型自建教程，含扩散语言模型与垂直法律应用，分量有限

arxiv.title: IndicIPR-QA: A Benchmark for Extractive Question Answering on Indian IPR Laws
arxiv.abstract: Legal Question Answering (QA) over statutory texts is a challenging task in Natural Language Processing (NLP), especially in low-resource settings with complex legal systems. It requires answers that are precise and grounded in the law. However, to the best of current knowledge, no existing extractive QA benchmark provides exact answer spans from statutory texts across all seven Indian Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Acts. This paper presents IndicIPR-QA1, an extractive QA benchmark for Indian IPR laws. The proposed dataset contains 4,462 QA pairs from 1,116 statutory contexts across seven Acts. Questions and answers are generated using GPT-4o and validated through nine automatic quality checks, single and multi-model LLM evaluations, and a 200-pair human audit. Section-level partitioning prevents source-context overlap across the training, validation, and test sets. Further analysis examines answer span length, lexical overlap, and multi-clause structure across the corpus and individual Acts. BM25 achieves a token-level F1 score of 20.21, while fine-tuned InLegalBERT reaches 85.02 under a unified sliding-window inference protocol. The large performance gap between BM25 (20.21 F1) and InLegalBERT (85.02 F1) shows that simple word matching is not enough to answer these legal questions. Performance also varies across the seven Acts, indicating substantial differences in answer-extraction performance.
arxiv.titleZh: IndicIPR-QA:面向印度知识产权法的抽取式问答基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向法律条文问答缺少可验证答案跨度的基准这一问题，构建覆盖印度七部知识产权法案的抽取式问答数据集，含1116段条文语境与4462个问答对，问答由GPT-4o生成并经九项自动质检、单模型与多模型LLM评估及200对人工审核，按章节切分避免训练/验证/测试的源文重叠;统一滑窗推理协议下BM25的token级F1仅20.21，微调InLegalBERT达85.02，说明单纯词面匹配不足以应对法律问答，且七部法案间性能差异明显。
arxiv.reason: 法律垂直领域抽取式QA基准，与后训练/Agent主线关联弱

arxiv.title: How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates
arxiv.abstract: Safety alignment for Large Language Models is heavily focused on English with limited multilingual representation, particularly damaging low-resource language performance. Related open training datasets are often limited in size or do not follow region-localized harmful topics to broaden the scope of alignment beyond cultures. We propose a scalable template-based augmentation pipeline to produce massive multilingual refusal and benign corpora, extracting safe templates from harmful prompts, translating them and then filling in the slots with culturally authentic entities, both harmful and benign. As a result, we release MSafeTemp, a validated corpus spanning 60 languages useful for multilingual safety alignment and evaluation. Using the dataset, we show that English-only evaluation misjudges multilingual safety: for several models, attacks that fail in English succeed once translated, while culturally localized variants expose further failures that translation alone misses. We also confirm that augmenting safety training data through templates allows for higher diversity and quality of alignment, resulting in improved safety performance beyond English. MSafeTemp and the respective pipeline are aimed at facilitating research and development of safer and more responsible models for less-represented cultures.
arxiv.titleZh: 我是如何对齐你的模型:用模板扩展多语言安全训练
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对LLM安全对齐严重偏重英语、低资源语言安全性不足的问题，提出可扩展的模板增强流水线:从有害提示中抽取安全模板并翻译，再用文化本地化的实体(有害与良性)填充槽位，批量生成多语言拒答与良性语料，发布覆盖60种语言的经验证数据集MSafeTemp。评估显示仅用英语评测会误判多语言安全性:多个模型在英语下失败的攻击翻译后即成功，文化本地化变体还暴露出翻译无法覆盖的额外失效。用模板增强安全训练数据可提升覆盖多样性与对齐质量，使英语之外的安全表现同步改善，适用于多语言安全对齐训练与评测。
arxiv.reason: 多语言安全对齐数据构造与训练，扎实命中后训练对齐方向

arxiv.title: A Low-Rank Space Captures Linear Alignment Between LLM and Human Neural Activity During Naturalistic Language Listening
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as computational models of human language processing, yet it remains unclear which components of their representations drive alignment with neural activity. Here, we use ridge reduced-rank regression to identify the brain-predictive subspace of LLM representations: the representational directions that support linear prediction of neural responses. Across three naturalistic language-listening datasets spanning intracranial electrophysiology and fMRI, and six model conditions spanning autoregressive, bidirectional masked, and randomly initialized language models, we find that full linear encoding performance can be recovered using only 1-3% of the original embedding dimensionality. These low-dimensional subspaces generalize across held-out participants and, to a lesser extent, across datasets, suggesting that neural predictivity is concentrated in a compact and partially shared representational space. We next compare these brain-predictive directions with the principal axes of variation in the embeddings. Principal component analysis requires substantially more dimensions to recover neural prediction, demonstrating that the directions most useful for predicting neural activity are distinct from those capturing the most overall variance within LLM representations themselves. Finally, characterizing the learned subspaces allows us to surface interpretable features that are overrepresented in neural activity above and beyond the LLM representations. Together, these results show that LLM-brain alignment is supported by a small, structured subset of model representations and provides a framework for better understanding exactly why these representations align. Code can be found at: https://github.com/thefinnlab/low-rank-alignment
arxiv.titleZh: 低秩空间捕捉自然语言聆听过程中LLM与人类神经活动的线性对齐
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM表征的哪些方向能预测人类语言处理时的神经活动尚不清楚。该工作用岭回归降秩回归识别LLM表征中的“脑预测子空间”，在覆盖颅内电生理与fMRI的三个自然语言聆听数据集、以及自回归、双向掩码和随机初始化等六种模型条件下，仅用原始嵌入维度的1%至3%即可恢复完整的线性编码性能。该低维子空间可跨被试泛化，并在较小程度上跨数据集泛化；其方向显著区别于PCA主成分，并揭示出神经活动中超出LLM表征的可解释特征。

arxiv.title: Algebraic World Model: From Exploration to Proofs
arxiv.abstract: AI has made remarkable progress in mathematics, solving challenging problems with machine-checkable proofs in Lean, yet typically relying on predefined mathematical definitions and formal specifications. This raises a natural question: can it reason rigorously about an unknown world? We introduce the Algebraic World Model (AWM), a framework that turns interaction with unfamiliar environments into explicit mathematical models supporting formal reasoning. AWM explores the environment and develops executable Python hypotheses, continually testing and revising them against observations. It then structures these hypotheses into typed objects and shared rules, simplifies their structure through category-theory-guided transformations, and formalizes the resulting model in Lean 4 to prove reachability and impossibility. AWM can formally prove that a goal is unreachable, even beyond explored trajectories. On two impossible game levels, it constructs closed, kernel-checked Lean proofs excluding every legal winning sequence in all six runs, while Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, equipped with coding tools, produce none in twelve baseline runs. Four of AWM's six initial bounds are correct, compared with one for Opus 5.5 and none for GPT-6 Astra; given only feedback that a cheaper win exists, AWM revises its rules and constructs new proofs, reaching six of six correct bounds. Moreover, AWM produces interpretable mathematical models whose rules can be inspected and tested step by step. Across all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games, these models enable Lean to replay the winning trajectories of all 183 levels and generalize beyond observed play, predicting unseen transitions and detecting changes in game mechanics. With Claude Opus 5, AWM clears all levels with a score of 99.9, while its certified winning trajectories use only 43% of the human baseline's actions.

arxiv.titleZh: 代数世界模型：从探索到证明
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 虽能在 Lean 中给出机器可检验的证明，却依赖预先给定的数学定义与形式化规格，难以对未知世界做严格推理。AWM 通过与环境交互提出可执行的 Python 假设，并反复检验与修正，再把假设组织为类型化对象与共享规则，借助范畴论引导的变换简化结构，最终在 Lean 4 中形式化，证明目标可达或不可达。在两个不可能通关的游戏关卡上，AWM 六次运行均构造出经 kernel 检验的封闭证明，排除全部合法获胜序列，而 Claude Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Astra 在十二次基线运行中均未给出任何证明；初始六个界中四个正确，仅凭“存在更省步数解法”的反馈修正规则后达到六个全对。在全部 25 个公开 ARC-AGI-3 游戏中，这些模型让 Lean 重放全部 183 关的获胜轨迹并能泛化预测未见转移、检测机制变化，配合 Claude Opus 5 取得 99.9 分，且认证轨迹仅用人类基线 43% 的动作数。

arxiv.title: Numerical Integration on Bounded Domains via Learned Reflected Diffusions
arxiv.abstract: We study high-dimensional integration on bounded convex domains. Given a non-negative integrand $r$, the goal is to estimate $Z=\int_{D}r(x)\,\mathrm dx$ on $D\subset\mathbb R^d$. Standard Quasi-Monte Carlo does not adapt its evaluation points to the integrand, while effective importance sampling requires a proposal that captures its concentration. Learned diffusion samplers can supply such a proposal, but existing methods are formulated on $\mathbb R^d$ and do not respect the domain constraint $x\in D$. We instead build the proposal from reflected dynamics that stay in $D$ by construction. A reflected diffusion progressively transforms the target distribution toward the uniform distribution on $D$, and a neural score model is trained to reverse this process. A change-of-measure formula for reflected diffusions yields a training objective without additional boundary terms and an unbiased importance-sampling estimator of $Z$. For non-smooth integrands, where reparameterization gradients may be undefined or uninformative, we derive a REINFORCE estimator of the training gradient using Gaussian proposal densities before reflection, without evaluating reflected transition densities or differentiating $r$. We evaluate on numerous synthetic targets and real-world problems, demonstrating strong performance of the proposed method, as well as favorable scaling with the dimension of the problem and the number of points used for the Monte Carlo estimate.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过学到的反射扩散在有界域上做数值积分
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对有界凸域上的高维积分 Z=∫_D r(x)dx，Quasi-Monte Carlo 不随被积函数自适应的难点，用构造上就停留在 D 内的反射扩散构造提议分布：反射扩散把目标分布逐步推向域上的均匀分布，再用神经得分模型学习反向过程；反射扩散的测度变换公式给出无额外边界项的训练目标与无偏重要性采样估计量。对被积函数 r 不光滑、重参数化梯度失效的情形，进一步用反射前的高斯提议密度推导 REINFORCE 训练梯度，无需计算反射转移密度或对 r 求导。在多个合成目标与真实问题上取得较强表现，并随维度与 Monte Carlo 点数呈现良好扩展性。

arxiv.title: Agentic University: Collaborative Agents for Personalized Learning
arxiv.abstract: Large language models support personalized tutoring, content generation, and adaptive learning paths. However, capability development requires these resources and interactions to form a coherent learning process that evolves with the learner. A central challenge is to align goals, activities, and assessment while using learning evidence to decide what should follow. We introduce Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization and instantiate it in Agentic University (AU). In AU, learners participate as organization members and work with specialized agents to maintain a revisable Capability Program. The program connects personal goals, learning activities across modalities, and layered assessment, while learner feedback and performance guide subsequent support. Our evaluation shows advantages in program organization, assessment design, and revision quality. Users achieved larger mean assessment gains (12.19 versus 5.61 points on a 50-point scale) and reported stronger cognitive support. This work contributes an organizational approach to adaptive learning that makes learner participation a continuing basis for multi-agent coordination. The Agentic University project is available at \href{https://github.com/AgenticOrgLab/AgenticUniversity.git}.
arxiv.titleZh: Agentic University:面向个性化学习的协作智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对个性化学习中目标、活动与评估难以对齐、学习证据难以驱动后续教学的问题，提出「人类参与的多智能体组织」(Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization)，并在 Agentic University 中落地:学习者作为组织成员与专用智能体协作维护可修订的「能力项目」，把个人目标、跨模态学习活动与分层评估串联起来，由学习者反馈与表现决定后续支持。评估显示项目组织、评估设计与修订质量均有优势，评估增益均值 12.19 分，对照为 5.61 分(50 分制)，学习者报告的认知支持也更强。工作给出一种以学习者持续参与为协调基础的多智能体自适应学习组织方式，适用于 AI 教育场景。

arxiv.title: rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Evaluating Early Stage Research Judgment
arxiv.abstract: Do research agents have taste, the judgment of which experiments are worth running before their outcomes are known? We give six frontier models seven recent NLP papers. Each model, working as a research agent alone or as a team, proposes minimum viable experiments (MVEs), forecasts whether each will pass a threshold it sets and ranks them. A separate executor then attempts every MVE, including those ranked last, and three model auditors judge the results. Of 415 MVEs, 194 are judged sound, valuable and new, but fewer than half of these (73) are also judged beyond the seed paper and non obvious. The agents' first choices match the auditors' most valued experiment more often than a random pick, but are not shown to improve on choosing the experiment written first. Their forecasts beat a base rate but are not measurably more accurate than those of a fresh instance of the same model given only the paper and registrations. Teams cost more without a clear overall improvement in proposal quality. The agents produce many worthwhile experiments, but the evidence that their rankings improve the choice of which to run remains limited. The evaluation harness and a dataset of all 415 MVEs, with their forecasts and audited outcomes, are available at https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste.

arxiv.titleZh: rTaste:研究智能体有品味吗?评估早期研究判断力
arxiv.summaryZh: 考察研究智能体能否在结果未知时判断哪些实验值得做:让六个前沿模型就七篇近期 NLP 论文独立或组队提出最小可行实验(MVE)，自行设定阈值、预测能否通过并排序，再由独立执行器执行包括排名最后在内的全部 MVE，由三个模型审计员评判结果。415 个 MVE 中有 194 个被判为有价值且新颖，但仅 73 个同时被判为超出种子论文且非显而易见;智能体的首选实验优于随机挑选，却未显示出胜过「论文中先写出的实验」，其预测优于基率但不及仅给论文与注册信息的同模型新实例，组队成本更高而提案质量无明显提升。工作给出可复用的评测 harness 与含预测与审计结果的 415 条 MVE 数据集，提示当前研究智能体的排序能力仍不足以可靠指导实验选择。

arxiv.title: The Precision Wall: An Optimizer-Dependent Boundary for Optimization under Power-Law Measurement Spectra
arxiv.abstract: In low-rank matrix sensing of a rank-$D$ factor $U^\ast \in \mathbb{R}^{V \times D}$, replacing isotropic Gaussian designs with power-law measurement covariance $Σ= \mathrm{diag}(j^{-s})_{j=1}^V$ leaves the Burer--Monteiro landscape free of spurious local minima, yet division-normalised first-order optimizers stall above a critical exponent $s^\ast$. We trace this failure to a numerical precision wall. At the ground truth, the smallest non-gauge expected Hessian eigenvalue scales at leading order as $V^{-(s+1)}D^{-s}$. When this curvature drops below the effective denominator floor $ε_O$ of optimizer $O$, normalisation noise overwhelms rare-direction gradients, yielding the leading-order boundary $s^\ast_O(V, D) = [\log(1/ε_O) - \log V]/\log(VD) + δ_O$, where $δ_O$ is a metric-dependent detection lag. With $δ_{\mathrm{Adam}}$ calibrated on four configurations and frozen, this formula predicts Adam's onset within $0.45$ across all 16 cells of a held-out grid ($V \in \{64,128,256,512\} \times D \in \{4,8,16,32\}$), separates fixed-$VD$ pairs, and distinguishes denominator-precision walls from conditioning and sign-quantisation walls. The approximation fails at $D = 2$, reflects a finite-$D$ spectral crossover, and saturates below $\varepsilon_0 = 10^{-8}$ at a dynamical floor.
arxiv.titleZh: 精度之墙:幂律测量谱下优化问题中依赖优化器的边界
arxiv.summaryZh: 低秩矩阵感知中，测量协方差从各向同性高斯换成幂律谱 Σ=diag(j^{-s}) 时，Burer-Monteiro 景观仍无伪局部极小，但除法归一化的优化器会在临界指数 s* 之上停滞。原因被定位为数值精度墙:真值处最小非规范期望 Hessian 特征值按 V^{-(s+1)}D^{-s} 缩放，低于优化器有效分母下限 ε_O 后，归一化噪声淹没稀有方向梯度，由此给出边界式 s*_O(V,D)=[log(1/ε_O)-log V]/log(VD)+δ_O。校准并冻结 δ_Adam 后，该式在 16 格留出网格(V 至 512、D 至 32)上把 Adam 的起始点预测在 0.45 误差内，并能区分分母精度墙与条件数墙、符号量化墙。为 Adam 的 ε 取值与低精度训练失效提供定量判据。
arxiv.reason: Adam 分母精度分析，触及优化器与训练稳定性，但偏理论小规模

arxiv.title: Preserving Utility in Continual LLM Unlearning via Orthogonal Projections
arxiv.abstract: Unlearning concerns the task of removing the influence of a sensitive portion of the training data, such as protected, copyrighted or private text, from a model without retraining it from scratch. While unlearning requests happen continuously during a model's lifetime, the vast majority of LLM unlearning methods are ill-suited for iterated removal, yielding steep decay in forgetting and utility upon sequential unlearning. This decay stems from interference between successive updates, as each new deletion can undo earlier ones or push the model further along directions already degraded by them. To address this, we introduce Continual Orthogonal Projection (COP), a gradient-projection scheme that restricts each update to the orthogonal complement of activation subspaces cached from prior forget sets. This approach provably guarantees first-order non-interference with earlier deletions. COP stores only a low-rank basis per layer, requiring neither past gradients nor previous forget sets, and plugs into unlearning methods that update the model through gradient steps on a differentiable loss without modifying its objective. Experiments on standard LLM unlearning benchmarks (TOFU and RWKU) show that COP preserves utility across sequential requests without weakening forgetting, preventing the collapse of standard objectives and forgetting more effectively than continual-specific baselines.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过正交投影在持续 LLM 遗忘中保持效用
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对持续到达的遗忘请求，现有 LLM 遗忘方法在顺序删除时遗忘效果与模型效用会急剧衰减，原因是连续更新相互干扰，新删除会撤销旧删除或沿着已被破坏的方向继续推进。提出的持续正交投影（COP）将每次梯度更新限制在由历史 forget set 激活缓存构成的正交补空间内，理论上保证对先前删除的一阶非干扰，且每层仅需存储低秩基，不依赖历史梯度或旧 forget set，可直接嵌入任意基于可微损失梯度更新的遗忘方法。在 TOFU 与 RWKU 基准上，COP 在顺序请求下保持效用且不削弱遗忘，避免标准目标崩溃，遗忘效果优于持续遗忘专用基线。

arxiv.title: FIRME: Registry-Anchored Memory Graphs for Evolving, Heterogeneous Investor Knowledge
arxiv.abstract: Financial AI workflows that reuse investor knowledge need persistent memory that integrates observations across sources and periods without losing identity or provenance. In a knowledge graph, recurring observations may use different surface forms, fragmenting relationship histories and preventing evidence from accumulating. We introduce Fusion and Identity Registry for Memory Evolution (FIRME), a registry-anchored memory graph that reconciles incoming observations to persistent canonical relationships and retains their source, time, and context. Within periods, rule-based fusion links investor-call discussions to portfolio cash-flow signals, directly or through a fixed product-topic ontology. Across periods, canonical identities and persistent aliases direct recurring observations to the same relationship history; deterministic updates summarize reinforcement, inactivity, and reactivation. We evaluate FIRME on proprietary investor-call and cash-flow records and on S&P 500 earnings-call transcripts. Compared with a historical registry that retains canonical identities and semantic fallback but omits alias memory, FIRME increases final-period Correct Match Rate by 7.8-12.1 percentage points across four dataset-backend settings under a fixed-judge and fallback-review protocol. A blinded human audit of 200 incoming observations per setting finds Correct Match Rate gains of 9.0-16.5 points and reattachment-recall gains of 22.5-29.0 points, with higher observed merge precision in all four samples. A separate audit finds valid evidence paths for 293 of 300 outputs from full within-period fusion in the investor-call setting. Extraction-faithfulness and round-trip diagnostics assess source grounding and preservation of extractor-derived graph content.

arxiv.titleZh: FIRME：面向演化、异构投资者知识的注册表锚定记忆图
arxiv.summaryZh: 金融 AI 工作流在复用投资者知识时，跨来源与跨时期的观测容易因表述不同而碎片化，导致关系历史断裂、证据无法累积，身份与出处也随之丢失。FIRME 用注册表锚定的记忆图把新观测对齐到持久的规范化关系，并保留来源、时间与上下文:期内以规则融合把投资者电话讨论与组合现金流信号直接或经固定产品—主题本体连接，跨期则靠规范化身份与持久别名把重复观测导入同一关系历史，并以确定性更新刻画强化、沉寂与复激活。在自有投资者电话与现金流记录以及 S&P 500 财报电话转写上的四组数据—后端设定中，末期正确匹配率比不做别名记忆的历史注册表高 7.8–12.1 个百分点;每设定 200 条盲审显示匹配率提升 9.0–16.5 点、重挂载召回提升 22.5–29.0 点，合并精度在四组样本中均更高，期内完整融合的 300 条输出中有 293 条证据路径有效。

arxiv.title: Training language models in simulation for psychiatric intake
arxiv.abstract: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ($N = 60$ matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. The trained agent outperformed the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ($p < 0.0001$), with gains on an adapted clinical-examination rubric ($d_z = 0.77$, $p < 0.0001$), patient-centered communication (82.0% vs. 65.2%, $p < 0.001$), and differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3%, $p < 0.001$). Across 127 psychiatrist-validated simulated intake scenarios, the trained agent nearly doubled its base model's clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, $p < 0.0001$). To systematically probe conversational safety, we established two Delphi-consensus taxonomies, of clinical safety risks and relational competencies, from which 256 challenging adversarial presentations were derived; we find that training in simulation environments more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks (12.9% vs. 30.5%, $p < 0.0001$). Simulation environments thus provide a controlled testbed for training and stress-testing psychiatric conversational agents, with gains that transferred to psychiatrist-enacted encounters, though residual gaps require safeguards and clinician oversight.

arxiv.titleZh: 在模拟环境中训练语言模型用于精神科接诊
arxiv.summaryZh: 精神科接诊访谈需要医生在建立信任的同时梳理复杂重叠的症状表现。该工作在模拟环境中用多轮强化学习训练语言模型完成结构化的文本接诊，覆盖病史采集、鉴别诊断与初步处置规划。一项随机双盲交叉研究中，60 对匹配场景、120 次接诊由 32 位精神科医师扮演标准化病人、15 位独立医师盲评，训练后智能体在 76.7% 的场景对中优于同提示的基座模型，临床检查量表效应量 d_z=0.77，以患者为中心的沟通得分 82.0% 对 65.2%，鉴别诊断恰当性 68.3% 对 33.3%。作者还用 Delphi 共识构建临床安全风险与关系能力两套分类体系，据此生成 256 个对抗性场景，急性安全风险的漏诊率由 30.5% 降至 12.9%。模拟环境可作为训练与压力测试对话智能体的可控平台，但残余差距仍需临床监督与防护措施。

arxiv.title: Rural Readiness: Domain Generalization with Adversarially Chosen Domains
arxiv.abstract: Predictive models trained at well-resourced data-rich institutions often fail when deployed in new populations. Motivated by the goal of building clinical diagnosis and decision-making algorithms for data-scarce rural populations using the general knowledge learned from data-rich hospitals, we formulate the fundamental question of \emph{domain generalization with adversarially chosen domains}, which asks a learner to perform on any unseen target domain nearly as well as the worst hypothesis consistent with the evidence from the observed source domains. Assuming only that the hypothesis class contains a "universal" predictor with small error on all $k$ source domains, we characterize the sample complexity of this objective up to logarithmic factors. Letting $d$ denote the VC dimension of the hypothesis class, we find, somewhat surprisingly, that the sample complexity reduces significantly from $Ω(dk)$ to $O(d)$ under a small relaxation of the learning goal in which, roughly speaking, we allow the learned model to compete with hypotheses that perform well on 99% instead of 100% of the source domains. By applying this insight to the meta-distributional setting, in which source domains are selected according to a distribution on distributions, we obtain a corresponding improvement over known sample complexity upper bounds. We also study the effect of data access to the target domain and show that a small labeled sample from the target domain does not improve the worst-case sample complexity on the source domains.
arxiv.titleZh: 乡村可用性：对抗选择域下的域泛化
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向把数据丰富医院训练的临床预测模型部署到数据稀缺乡村人群的需求，提出“对抗选择域”的域泛化设定：学习器在任意未见目标域上的表现，需接近与源域证据相符的最差假设。在假设类中存在对全部 k 个源域误差均很小的通用预测器的前提下，刻画该目标的样本复杂度（至对数因子）；当把竞争目标从在 100% 源域上表现良好放宽到 99% 时，样本复杂度由 Ω(dk) 降至 O(d)，d 为 VC 维。将该结论用于源域按“分布的分布”选取的元分布设定，得到优于已知上界的样本复杂度，并表明目标域的少量标注样本无法改善源域最坏情况复杂度。属学习理论分析，可为跨机构、跨人群的域泛化提供理论参考。

arxiv.title: Glance: The Generator Is Its Own Reranker
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation commonly serves separate models for reranking and answering, duplicating model residency and passage processing. We introduce Glance, which equips the generator with a lightweight decision adapter and pointer head to score candidate passages from a shared prefill. Short relevance probes branch from the cached context, producing one score per passage without separately prefilling each query-passage pair. A single resident 9B backbone supports generation, general decisions and reranking, with approximately 0.1 GiB of additional memory per decision skill. After 39 minutes of MS MARCO fine-tuning, Glance achieves nDCG@10 of 0.741 on SciFact and 0.345 on NFCorpus, compared with 0.721 and 0.326 for bge-reranker-v2-m3. On 300 HotpotQA questions, its selected context improves answer F1 by 0.045 over cross-encoder-selected context under the same base generator (paired bootstrap 95% CI [0.014, 0.076]). In a scaling study, reranking quality keeps rising up to 200 candidates (43k tokens) scored from one shared prefill, where it exceeds the cross-encoder by 0.058 nDCG@10, and a probe-only activated adapter lets generation continue from the original passage cache. These initial results demonstrate generator-based reranking with one resident backbone; evaluation currently covers two retrieval datasets, one QA dataset and one backbone family.

arxiv.title: Reinforcement learning for control of partial differential equations
arxiv.abstract: Controlling dynamical systems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) remains a challenging task in scientific computing, owing to high-dimensional state spaces, distributed actuation, nonlinear dynamics, and stringent real-time constraints. Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for synthesizing feedback controllers that adapt to varying operating conditions and can be deployed efficiently in real-time. This review provides a unified perspective on RL and PDE-constrained optimization, and surveys model-free, model-based, and multi-agent RL approaches to PDE control, with particular emphasis on sample efficiency, generalization across parametric variations, and scalability to high-dimensional problems. Two demonstrative examples, the stabilization of a chaotic system and a flow control problem, illustrate the performance and pitfalls of RL agents in practice. Finally, we discuss evaluation and benchmarking practices, current limitations, and open research directions toward reliable, data-efficient, and scalable RL for scientific computing.
arxiv.titleZh: 用于偏微分方程控制的强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对偏微分方程约束的动力系统控制难题（高维状态空间、分布式驱动、非线性、实时性约束），系统梳理强化学习与PDE约束优化的统一视角，综述无模型、基于模型与多智能体三类RL方法，重点关注样本效率、跨参数变化的泛化与高维可扩展性。以混沌系统镇定与流动控制两个示例展示RL智能体的实际表现与失败模式，并讨论评测与基准实践、现有限制及可靠、数据高效、可扩展的开放方向。

arxiv.title: Prefix Executability: Evaluating Tool-Using Agents Beyond Final Success
arxiv.abstract: Tool-use benchmarks often score agents by final task success, but terminal outcomes can obscure whether the intermediate tool-call trajectory was executable. We propose prefix executability as a trajectory-level evaluation protocol for tool-using agents. The protocol measures whether every prefix of a predicted tool-call sequence remains executable under tool schemas, state preconditions, and data dependencies, and summarizes reliability using Prefix Executability Curves (PEC), First-Error Depth (FED), Trajectory Executability Rate (TER), horizon-normalized AUC-PEC, and Recovery Rate (RR). We instantiate the protocol on stratified samples from BFCL-v3 multi-turn and ToolSandbox, and on the complete Airline/Retail base splits of $τ^3$-bench. We observe that outcome-only and prefix-level rankings diverge: agents whose execution is conditioned on an unverified plan often achieve higher point-estimate final success than non-plan-conditioned baselines while substantially lowering TER and AUC-PEC. These divergences are precisely the failure modes that prefix executability is designed to expose: they reveal whether apparent success rests on an executable trajectory, where invalidity first enters, and whether success follows recovery from an earlier failure. As a validation intervention, explicit pre-execution plan checking can improve executable-prefix survival while maintaining competitive terminal success. These results show that final success alone is insufficient for evaluating tool-use agents and that prefix-level executability provides an actionable reliability signal for comparing agents, diagnosing failures, and assessing validation mechanisms.
arxiv.titleZh: 前缀可执行性：超越最终成功率来评估工具使用 Agent
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对仅以最终任务成功率评估工具调用 Agent、掩盖中间轨迹是否可执行的问题，提出轨迹级协议「前缀可执行性」：检验预测的工具调用序列每个前缀在工具 schema、状态前置条件与数据依赖下是否仍可执行，并用前缀可执行性曲线（PEC）、首次错误深度（FED）、轨迹可执行率（TER）、按时间步长归一化的 AUC-PEC 与恢复率（RR）加以汇总。在 BFCL-v3 多轮与 ToolSandbox 的分层样本、以及 τ³-bench 的 Airline/Retail 完整基础划分上实例化该协议，发现仅看结果的排序与前缀级排序出现分歧：依赖未验证计划执行调用的 Agent 最终成功率点估计更高，但 TER 与 AUC-PEC 明显更低。作为验证干预，执行前的显式计划检查可提升可执行前缀的存活率，同时保持有竞争力的最终成功率，说明单看最终成功率不足以评估工具使用 Agent。

arxiv.title: Framework-Conditional Open Materials Generation
arxiv.abstract: Theoretical predictions of novel materials rely on a variety of techniques, from data-mining-based ion substitution methods to fully de novo generative models. Each approach imposes specific constraints and encounters unique challenges when extrapolating beyond the distribution of known materials to discover new ones. The foremost goal of materials generation is to produce stable, unique, and novel (S.U.N.) structures. Predicted structures that meet these criteria, however, typically result from novel chemical compositions mapped onto known structural prototypes or frameworks. We leverage this heuristic insight to present a new generative paradigm for the de novo prediction of inorganic crystalline materials constrained by their structural framework---i.e., the unit cell shapes and respective particle positions. Our method, termed OMatG-FC (Open Materials Framework-Conditional Generation), learns via a combination of discrete flow matching on the atomic species and stochastic interpolants for the volume scaling of the unit cell lattice, while fixing in-place the fractional coordinates and the unit-volume lattice vectors, dramatically reducing the dimensionality of the problem compared to unconstrained (framework-free) generation. Our method is more flexible than existing prototype-constrained methods, demonstrating capability for discovery of unseen, stable prototypes derived from known structural frameworks. We also investigate the number of unique frameworks in the MP-20 dataset, demonstrating the propensity of duplicate frameworks within the dataset and providing a framework-split version. We benchmark the performance of our model using the LeMat-GenBench suite using three ML interatomic potentials and achieve state-of-the-art S.U.N. rate below the convex hull, eschewing the need to learn atomic packings for materials discovery.
arxiv.titleZh: 框架条件化的开放材料生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 无机晶体材料的从头生成通常只能在已知结构原型上替换化学成分，难以跳出已知框架发现新结构。OMatG-FC 把结构框架（晶胞形状与粒子位置）作为条件固定住，只对原子种类做离散流匹配、对晶胞体积缩放做随机插值，从而把生成问题的维度大幅降低，同时比原型约束方法更灵活。作者还统计了 MP-20 中重复框架的比例并给出按框架划分的数据集版本，在 LeMat-GenBench 上用三种机器学习原子间势做评测，取得凸包以下 S.U.N.（稳定、独特、新颖）率的最优结果，表明材料发现可以绕开原子堆积的学习。

arxiv.title: A Pretrained Model for Bayesian Filtering in Heterogeneous Dynamical Systems
arxiv.abstract: Filtering has not yet had its foundation-model moment: state estimation is still dominated either by online Bayesian filtering algorithms that require known dy- namics as inputs, or by learning-based neural filters trained from scratch for a single system or parametric family. The core challenge is structural heterogene- ity: dynamical systems differ in their governing dynamics, physical scales, and noise levels, precluding a shared representation space for a reusable filter. To bridge this gap, we introduce FilterFM, the first pretrained model for Bayesian filtering that estimates latent states across heterogeneous dynamical systems with a single checkpoint. FilterFM employs a hierarchical two-level observation se- quence encoder and a prior-to-posterior state-reconstruction module that together handle varying observation and state dimensions across heterogeneous systems, while modeling state uncertainty via quantile prediction. Trained on a mixture of heterogeneous filtering tasks, FilterFM exhibits superior in-domain performance, delivering significant gains in estimation accuracy, runtime efficiency, and noise robustness compared to existing baselines. Beyond in-domain performance, it marks the first model to successfully enable zero-shot filtering on unseen dynamics, bridging the generalization gap in state estimation. Furthermore, we uncover clear scaling behaviors in foundation-model-based Bayesian filtering, which combined with comprehensive component ablation studies, validate the structural optimality of our design and broaden the generalization scope for this research field.

arxiv.title: Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis: integrating reinforcement learning and conformal prediction for reliable wafer defect classification
arxiv.abstract: Semiconductor manufacturing is a complex, multi-step process that requires both high precision and low operating costs. Therefore, detecting defects in a high-volume setting is an important component of wafer map analysis for reliable production. However, most state-of-the-art deep learning approaches require a full scan of the surface, which hinders the development of high-throughput inspection systems. To address this problem, we propose Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis (UFLD), a novel algorithm that employs reinforcement learning for adaptive measurement acquisition and provides a prediction uncertainty level after each step, stopping the process once sufficient information is obtained. Unlike existing methods that rely on ensemble models or auxiliary confidence estimation deep learning models, UFLD utilizes a more parameter-efficient conformal prediction framework to determine the optimal stopping time. The proposed UFLD reduces acquisition time by about $40\%$ and achieves $98.4\%$ inspection accuracy, without requiring an additional learned confidence-estimation network. We validated our approach on the MixedWM38 dataset, demonstrating its advantages over existing adaptive acquisition procedures and standard convolutional neural networks.
arxiv.titleZh: 不确定性感知的反馈回路诊断：融合强化学习与保形预测实现可靠的晶圆缺陷分类
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向晶圆图缺陷检测中全表面扫描耗时、难以支撑高通量检测的问题，提出不确定性感知反馈回路诊断（UFLD），用强化学习自适应决定下一步测量区域，并在每步后借助保形预测给出预测不确定性，当信息足够时即停止采集，无需额外训练置信度估计网络，比依赖集成模型或辅助置信度模型的做法更省参数。在MixedWM38数据集上，采集时间缩短约40%，检测准确率达98.4%，优于现有自适应采集流程与标准卷积网络。该方法面向半导体制造的过程检测场景，属于不确定性量化与序贯决策结合的工业视觉应用。

arxiv.title: NECA: Neighbor Event Curve Augmentation for Multi-Horizon ICU Deterioration Prediction
arxiv.abstract: Early prediction of ICU organ dysfunction events supports timely clinical monitoring and intervention, but estimating short-term organ-specific risk from early ICU records remains challenging due to irregular measurements, heterogeneous clinical variables, and the need to predict risk across multiple future horizons. Existing supervised models usually treat each patient as an isolated sample and do not explicitly use the observed event timing of similar historical patients. We propose Neighbor Event-Curve Augmentation (NECA), a model-agnostic method that retrieves training-set patients with similar early-window profiles and converts their subsequent organ dysfunction event onset times into cumulative event-curve features over 6h, 12h, 24h, and 42h. These features are concatenated with the original patient representation and used by standard downstream predictors. On PhysioNet 2012 and a 4,000-stay MIMIC-IV subset, NECA improves average PR-AUC and ROC-AUC across four organ dysfunction event tasks and seven supervised learners. The largest gain appears for neurological dysfunction events, where task-level average PR-AUC increases from 0.461 to 0.557 on PhysioNet 2012. Ablations show that clinically meaningful retrieval and horizon-specific neighbor risk drive most of the improvement, while the full cumulative curve adds task-dependent temporal context. These results support similar-patient event timing as a structured temporal risk signal for ICU organ dysfunction event prediction. The source code will be publicly released upon acceptance of this paper.
arxiv.titleZh: NECA:用于多时间跨度 ICU 恶化预测的邻居事件曲线增强
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向 ICU 早期器官功能障碍事件预测中测量不规则、变量异构以及需要同时估计 6h、12h、24h、42h 多个未来时间点风险的问题，提出与模型无关的邻居事件曲线增强方法 NECA。该方法在训练集中检索早期窗口画像相似的患者，把他们的后续器官功能障碍事件发生时间转换为各时间跨度上的累积事件曲线特征，与原始患者表征拼接后交给标准下游预测器。在 PhysioNet 2012 与 4000 条 MIMIC-IV 子集上，跨四类器官障碍任务与七种监督学习器均提升平均 PR-AUC 与 ROC-AUC，神经系统障碍任务提升最大，PhysioNet 2012 上任务级平均 PR-AUC 从 0.461 升到 0.557。消融显示提升主要来自有临床意义的检索与分跨度邻居风险特征，完整累积曲线提供依赖任务的时间上下文。

arxiv.title: IMPACT: Inverter-Informed Multimodal Learning for Photovoltaic Generation Forecasting
arxiv.abstract: This work develops a physics-informed multimodal deep learning framework for 10- to 110-minute-ahead probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasting. The forecasting model is built on a four-branch architecture that separately encodes plant-level temporal history and inverter-level spatial cloud dynamics through a graph attention encoder with a learned adjacency, known-future solar geometry, and the current meteorological state, fused through gated cross-attention. The geometry branch adds two forward-looking physical signals, spatial cloud heterogeneity and inverter ramp-down activity, each empirically weighted toward the horizon where it is most predictive. The decoder anchors its prediction to a smart persistence baseline, learning a horizon-conditioned correction, and the resulting quantile forecasts are calibrated online through a kernel-weighted adaptive conformal calibration step. The proposed model outperforms all 14 baselines, achieving a forecast skill score (FSS) of 0.2950, 0.099 above the next-best model. A branch-composition ablation shows that every branch contributes positively and the model retains substantial skill in challenging overcast and variable sky conditions (FSS 0.198 and 0.255).

arxiv.title: Retrieving from Your Own Mistakes: On-Policy Training of Embedding Models for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
arxiv.abstract: Complex questions in retrieval-augmented generation require evidence spread over several documents, and an answer is reliable only when the retriever finds all of it. Chain embedding retrievers collect such evidence step by step, re-encoding the question together with the passages retrieved so far, and we find that they are already strong: trained only on gold histories, a small chain embedding retriever that calls no language model outperforms graph-based systems and is competitive with a search agent. This training, however, leaves a gap. At test time the retriever conditions on its own retrievals, which soon contain mistakes: by the third step, about half or more of the states it visits hold a wrong passage, and these passages lower its chance of retrieving a missing gold passage well beyond what the difficulty of the states explains. We propose on-policy state training, which trains the encoder on the states it reaches itself. At every epoch the current encoder retrieves chains for the training questions; each state it visits, including those built on its own mistakes, is labeled with the earliest gold passage still missing while the other missing gold passages are masked, so that no correct continuation is penalized; and the encoder is updated contrastively on these states mixed with teacher-forced ones, so that its training distribution follows it as it learns. The resulting retriever retrieves complete evidence more often than teacher-forced training and the systems we compare, and it transfers without further training to harder long-chain variants of HotpotQA and 2WikiMultiHopQA that we construct. On the same states, it recovers from its own mistakes far more often, and controlled comparisons attribute the gain to training on the states the encoder currently reaches.
arxiv.titleZh: 从自身错误中检索：面向多跳检索增强生成的嵌入模型在线策略训练
arxiv.summaryZh: 链式嵌入检索器逐步重编码问题与已检索段落来收集多跳证据，但仅在金标准历史上训练会带来训练—测试分布错位：测试时它条件于自身检索结果，到第三步时约有一半以上状态已含错误段落，且这些错误对后续检索的损害超出状态难度本身。为此提出在线策略状态训练：每轮用当前编码器为训练问题实际检索链条，将每个到达状态（包括建立在自身错误上的状态）标注为最早缺失的金标准段落、掩蔽其余缺失段落以避免惩罚正确续接，再与教师强制状态混合做对比学习更新，使训练分布随模型同步演进。所得检索器检索到完整证据的比例高于教师强制训练与对比系统，并可零样本迁移到自行构造的更长链 HotpotQA 与 2WikiMultiHopQA 变体；在相同状态上从自身错误恢复的比例显著提升，控制实验将增益归因于在线策略状态训练。

arxiv.title: SCARL: Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning by scoring sampled responses with a rule-based verifier and reinforcing those that pass. Where a classifier's training couples predicted probability to labels, nothing ties an RLVR policy's confidence in a response to its reward: aligned training would drive responses with the same advantage toward equal confidence, yet the advantage is blind to confidence. Under this sequence-confidence misalignment, a success the policy barely found earns the same update as one it produces with near certainty, and a confident error is corrected no harder than an exploratory one. We propose SCARL (Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning), which reshapes, but never re-signs, each advantage with the alignment gap between the response's group-relative confidence and the outcome its advantage certifies, normalized into shares of each class's advantage budget. Misaligned samples absorb the force, responses with the same advantage are driven toward equal confidence, and repairing the misalignment doubles as a remedy for the entropy collapse that erodes exploration. SCARL provably reduces to its base estimator when a class's confidences agree, adds no extra passes and one hyperparameter. On Qwen3-4B-Base it lifts average Pass@32 by 2.4 points over DAPO and is best among nine compute-matched methods on both coverage and per-draw accuracy; applied unchanged across four estimators and four backbones, it improves 14 of 16 settings while preserving policy entropy and widening the confidence-correctness separation. Our code is available at https://github.com/kezhh163/scarl.
arxiv.titleZh: SCARL:序列置信度对齐的强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: RLVR 用规则验证器给采样回答打分并强化通过者，但策略对回答的置信度与奖励之间缺乏约束:同一 advantage 的样本置信度可能差异巨大，勉强猜对与十拿九稳得到同等更新。SCARL 以组内相对置信度与 advantage 所认证结果的对齐差重塑(不改变符号)每个 advantage，并按类别预算归一化，让失配样本承担主要修正力度;置信度一致时可证明退化为原估计器，不增额外前向、只多一个超参。Qwen3-4B-Base 上平均 Pass@32 较 DAPO 提升 2.4 分，九种等算力方法中覆盖率与单次准确率最优;跨四种估计器与四个基座套用，16 个设置中 14 个提升，并保持策略熵、扩大置信度—正确性间隔。

arxiv.title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
arxiv.abstract: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380K structured proof-supervision records while preserving chapter order, proposition-proof links, dependency references, and source provenance. Leveraging these structural signals, we explore curriculum learning across multiple mathematical subjects and characterize scaling patterns with supervision volume and source breadth. At full scale, fine-tuning on TOME-Math raises the unweighted mean score across our held-out evaluations and established public benchmarks by 16.7 percentage points over the base model, while exceeding all three public instruction-data baselines evaluated in aggregate. Our findings highlight structured textbooks as both a scalable source of mathematical supervision and an empirical framework for studying the impact of data organization on mathematical reasoning. We will release the corpus to facilitate further research on structured mathematical supervision.
arxiv.titleZh: 从结构化教科书扩展数学证明监督
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有数学监督数据通常被压平成孤立的题解对，教材本身的课程组织与证据结构随之丢失。TOME-Math把2,118本大学核心数学教材转换为约38万条结构化证明监督记录，保留章节顺序、命题与证明的链接、依赖引用和来源溯源，并利用这些结构信号做跨学科课程学习，刻画监督数据量与来源广度的scaling规律。全量微调后，模型在留出评测与公开基准上的无加权平均分比基座提升16.7个百分点，聚合结果超过三个公开指令数据基线。该工作说明结构化教科书既是可扩展的数学监督来源，也为研究数据组织方式对数学推理的影响提供了实证框架。

arxiv.title: Composing and Steering Diffusion Models with Generalized Feynman-Kac Correctors
arxiv.abstract: Diffusion models have become the leading paradigm in generative modeling, yet many applications require sampling from distributions that are not those of any single pretrained model, but are instead defined through combinations of several models, possibly tilted toward high values of a downstream reward. Naively combining the scores of the models yields incorrect samples, while existing corrections are restricted to specific families of targets. In this work, we introduce the generalized Feynman-Kac correctors (GFKC), a principled framework for sampling from an arbitrary target function of several pretrained diffusion models. We show that the geometric interpolation between an arbitrary initial function and the target function of the models satisfies a Feynman--Kac partial differential equation, and derive its potential in closed form. To evaluate this potential during generation, we further generalize the log-probability ODE to track the density of each model along trajectories driven by a different velocity field. The resulting algorithm operates entirely in the log domain, incorporates reward-based steering at no additional conceptual cost, and corrects the generation on the fly, without retraining or fine-tuning the models. We validate the method on analytic Gaussian models, where it closely matches the ground-truth targets, and on diffusion models trained on MNIST, where it samples from non-trivial combinations of the models and enables effective steering.
arxiv.titleZh: 用广义 Feynman-Kac 校正器组合与引导扩散模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 多模型组合或按下游奖励倾斜的分布无法由单个预训练扩散模型采样，直接相加 score 会产生错误样本，现有校正方法只覆盖特定目标族。GFKC 将任意初始函数到目标函数的几何插值表述为满足 Feynman-Kac 偏微分方程的形式并给出闭式势函数，同时推广对数概率 ODE，使由不同速度场驱动的轨迹仍可追踪各模型密度。算法全程在对数域运行，无需重训或微调即可在线校正生成，并以极小的额外代价实现奖励引导。在解析高斯模型上采样与真值吻合，在 MNIST 扩散模型上完成非平凡的多模型组合与有效引导。
arxiv.reason: 扩散模型采样与引导理论，属画像明确的低分方向

arxiv.title: Beyond Selected Breakthroughs: Evaluating Language Models on Randomly Sampled Mathematical Conjectures
arxiv.abstract: The last year has seen a shift in AI-assisted mathematics, with frontier language models producing proofs of and counterexamples to long-standing open conjectures. However, studying only the current set of major breakthroughs provides an incomplete picture of LLM capabilities and the computational resources needed to achieve reported results. To address this, we introduce a new dataset, OpenConjecture, which collects conjectures from mathematics papers published on the arXiv since February 2026. We use these conjectures as a source of open mathematical problems, and apply frontier GPT models to a random sample of 200 of these conjectures over three passes using a reproducible protocol without problem-specific mathematical guidance. Rather than attempt expert verification of these candidate solutions, we analyze the types of problems for which LLMs produce solutions and the characteristics of these solutions. The models we test produce candidate solutions for roughly 60% of the conjectures, with counterexamples about 1.3 times more common than proofs. We estimate solution novelty, assess how solutions cite and relate to existing literature, and analyze whether the proposed resolution relies on either an error in or underspecification of the conjecture. We find that models sometimes propose resolutions that are outside the authors' intent (e.g., proposing the trivial group as a counterexample) and that a number of proofs follow closely from existing results, but that some resolutions exhibit at least moderate novelty. Our findings underscore the need for evaluations that go beyond correctness to assess fidelity to the intended statement, attribution, and the nature of the mathematical contribution.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越精选突破：在随机采样的数学猜想上评估语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 以往对LLM数学能力的评估多集中在少数已公开的重大突破上，难以反映模型的真实水平与所需算力。为此构建OpenConjecture数据集，从2026年2月以来arXiv数学论文中收集未解决猜想，随机抽取200条，在无问题专用引导的可复现协议下让前沿GPT模型各跑三遍。模型对约60%的猜想给出候选解，反例数量约为证明的1.3倍；进一步评估解法新颖性、与已有文献的引用关系，以及是否依赖猜想本身的错误或表述不清，发现部分解法偏离作者原意（如以平凡群作反例）、部分证明紧贴已有结果，但也有少数具备中等新颖性。结果表明数学评测需超越正确性，同时考察对原命题意图的忠实度、归因与贡献性质。
arxiv.reason: LLM数学推理评测基准，属评测方法学方向，扎实但非旗舰

arxiv.title: Is It the Curriculum or Just the Easy Start? Benchmarking Unsupervised Environment Design on Quadrupeds
arxiv.abstract: Unsupervised environment design (UED) methods such as PLR, ACCEL, SFL and PAIRED are compared mostly on 2D mazes, grid worlds and BipedalWalker, while terrain curricula for legged robots are hand-designed and evaluated against a few baselines. We present a benchmark that runs fourteen UED, domain-randomisation and robotics curricula under one protocol on five 3D quadrupeds in MuJoCo MJX: the closed-chain W01-TEK and the open-chain Unitree Go1 and Go2, Google Barkour vB and Boston Dynamics Spot. Levels are vectors of eight interpretable terrain parameters, and all curricula drive the same PPO student at matched environment-step budgets. The evaluation reports success on random and held-out structured terrains, interquartile means with stratified bootstrap intervals, capability envelopes and a level-by-level domination comparison. We compare methods within each robot and report, per level set, the top group of methods not significantly below the best. No method is in the top group on every robot and level set. Methods with easy or low-difficulty training levels, curated or not, fill the top groups on in-distribution random levels of Go1 and Barkour, and of W01-TEK apart from PAIRED+BiBC. The success-driven terrain curriculum from legged-robot practice is in a top group most often, domain randomisation on uniform levels in none, and PAIRED in none outside Spot, where the fourteen methods lie within 3.8 points on random levels of difficulty 0.25. On three robots the leader on in-distribution random levels is not the leader on held-out terrain. We collect the results into a per-robot guide to choosing a curriculum.

arxiv.titleZh: 是课程设计，还是仅仅容易的起点？在四足机器人上基准测试无监督环境设计
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对UED方法多在2D迷宫与BipedalWalker上比较、四足机器人地形课程多为手工设计且基线有限，构建统一基准：在MuJoCo MJX的5种3D四足上，以相同PPO学生和匹配环境步数预算运行14种UED、域随机化与机器人课程，地形级别用8维可解释参数表示。评测覆盖随机与留出结构化地形的成功率、分层bootstrap区间、能力包络和逐级支配比较。没有方法在所有机器人和级别集上居首；含简单训练级别的方法在Go1、Barkour及W01-TEK的分布内随机级别上常进前列，PAIRED仅在Spot上进入前列，且三种机器人上分布内领先者并非留出地形领先者。
